remedies: Providing a free insulation kit to consumers, advising them to shut off the heaters until the kit is installed, and suggesting draining the spa to prevent damage in freezing temperatures.

recall_description: The chair can be misassembled so that the fabric seat can come off the chair's frame, exposing metal support rods and posing a laceration and fall hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should contact the company to receive a free repair kit with new assembly instructions and four straps to prevent the fabric seat from coming off.
visual_product_description: A child's director-style chair, constructed of tubular metal with a canvas seat and back. The chairs feature popular characters and have model numbers on a label on the leg of the chair.

recall_description: These electric pressure washers do not have a ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) on the power cord, which poses a serious electrocution hazard if the unit comes into contact with water.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the electric pressure washers immediately. A portable GFCI will be provided to attach to the end of the power cord to provide shock protection.
visual_product_description: yellow with a black three-prong power cord, labeled "Turbo Tiger Power Washer."

recall_description: The rose-shaped buttons on these garments can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using these garments, and return them for a refund.
visual_product_description: These are one-piece coveralls, and two-piece, babydoll-style top and legging sets. These 100 percent cotton garments were sold in sizes 0-3M to 24M. Writing on the collar labels includes, 'MADE IN CHINA'. The tops of the coveralls are made of plush, peach-colored knit fabric, with cream-colored collars and sleeve edges. The coverall tops have three cream-colored, rose-shaped buttons attached to the center front, from the neck to the waist, and are embroidered with a cream-colored rose. The bottoms of the coveralls have eight snaps at the crotch, and are printed with peach- and purple-colored roses, and peach-colored dots, on a cream-colored knit fabric. The babydoll tops are made of plush, cream-colored knit fabric, with peach-colored collars and sleeve edges. The tops have three peach-colored, rose-shaped buttons attached to the center front, from the neck to the waist, and are decorated with six peach-colored rosettes along the front waist. Leggings sold with these tops have purple, lavender and peach stripes on a cream-colored knit fabric.

recall_description: Inflatable playrings pose a suffocation risk to babies as the soft surface can cover the baby's nose and mouth, restricting airflow.
remedies: Consumers should discard or destroy the playrings as the firm is out of business and a refund is no longer available.
visual_product_description: The playring measures 40 inches in diameter, has a yellow, plastic, inflatable inner tube with a multicolor cloth covering that features activities such as a boat rattle, mirror flower, soft teether, butterfly, squeak ball, and fish.

recall_description: The mulch plates were manufactured with the wrong material, making them brittle and easy to crack or break when struck by stones or sticks. This poses a risk of injury from objects or fragments.
product_name: Walk-behind lawn mowers with 21-inch cutting width
remedies: Consumers should stop using the mowers in the mulching mode and contact the company to receive a replacement mulch cover plate.

recall_description: The brackets that attach the aero bars' forearm pads, where riders rest their arms, can loosen or separate during use, causing the rider to lose control and crash.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled aero bars immediately and contact the company to receive two free replacement brackets.
visual_product_description: Handlebar extensions for bicycles that allow aerodynamic crouching position. Includes brackets for forearm pads.

recall_description: small parts of the rattle can detach and pose a choking hazard to young children
remedies: Consumers should take the rattle away from children immediately and return it to the store for a refund
visual_product_description: The rattle is covered with a yellow cloth and is approximately 5 inches long, featuring a small blue and white bib around its neck that can detach.

recall_description: The amplifier's capacitors can overheat, blow a fuse, and damage the products to which they are connected, presenting a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the amplifiers immediately and contact the distributor for information on how to obtain free repair of the recalled product.
visual_product_description: Loudspeaker system comes in black ash, American cherry, or maple; power amplifiers come in black or silver with dimensions 3 inches by 15 inches by 14 inches for AV5105 model and 3 inches by 12 ½ inches by 12 ¾ inches for LK240 model.

recall_description: If the pressurized can is left in a hot automobile, it can forcefully break apart and cause injury to a nearby consumer. Explosion/Projectiles
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the recalled product away from children and contact the company for information on receiving a free replacement product.

recall_description: Water can leak from the metal holding tank, wet insulating material and cause electrical arcing and heat build-up, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers with affected units will receive a replacement insulation shield.

recall_description: The Power Inflator Buttons can stick, causing uncontrolled inflation and potentially rapid ascent, leading to decompression sickness or embolism.
remedies: Consumers should stop using inflators and take them to authorized dealers for free repair.
visual_product_description: The inflators have flow-through holes in the hand grip of the lower inflator mechanism.

recall_description: The riding mower's exhaust system can ignite fuel vapors from spilled fuel if the engine backfires, causing fire hazards and burn injuries.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the mowers and contact the dealer to schedule a repair of the riding mower's exhaust system.
visual_product_description: Red riding mowers equipped with 17 to 23 horsepower engines, mowing decks from 44 to 52 inches, independently controlled rear-drive wheels, front casters, and a centrally mounted mowing deck.

recall_description: The switches on the power tools can stick, causing the drills to continue operating after the trigger is released, posing a risk of injury.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these drills immediately and contact the tool manufacturer to receive a free tool repair.
visual_product_description: These are heavy-duty electric drills used in construction for drilling studs and joists.

recall_description: The plastic air intake chamber of the air-powered toy planes can burst, throwing plastic pieces, posing a laceration, bruise and abrasion hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the planes immediately and contact the manufacturer to receive a free replacement plane.
visual_product_description: The recalled planes involve two models: a red or blue model with a flame graphic across the body with "Firestormer" printed on the wings, and a purple, green, and white model with "Skyblazer" printed on the wings. These are air-powered and use a hand pump mechanism.

recall_description: The fuel tanks on these mowers can crack and leak fuel, posing a fire hazard and risk of burn injuries to consumers.
remedies: Free installation of a replacement fuel tank
visual_product_description: blue riding lawn mowers

recall_description: During the broil and self-clean modes, the range can emit high levels of carbon monoxide, presenting the potential for CO poisoning to consumers. Additionally, the temperature of the storage drawer can become extremely high, presenting the risk of burn injuries to consumers.
product_name: 30-inch self-clean gas ranges with broil and storage drawer functions
remedies: Consumers should stop using the self-clean or broil functions and call for an in-home inspection and free repair.

recall_description: Small metal screws holding the toy stall doors can come off, posing an aspiration or choking hazard to young children.
product_name: Animal Sounds Toy Set with Barn
remedies: Consumers should take the toy away from young children immediately and contact the company to receive a free repair kit. Consumers can also determine if their product is among the recalled models and order the free repair kit online.

recall_description: The shoes have a thin metal strip on the outside of the heel that can protrude from the shoe and form a sharp edge that can cut consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these cross-training shoes immediately and contact the company to receive free replacement shoes.

recall_description: The plug that connects the detachable control switch to the blanket can become loose, resulting in poor electrical contacts that can overheat and pose a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the electric blankets immediately and contact the manufacturer for a free replacement plug connector adapter.

recall_description: The bicycle forks can break apart, causing riders to lose control, fall and suffer serious injury.
remedies: Free replacement of the front suspension fork and free installation.
visual_product_description: Blue mountain bicycles with front suspension forks and 'Ultra Shock' written on the down tube in white lettering.

recall_description: Plastic parts in the pump connected to the camping stove can crack or become dislodged, permitting gas to leak.
remedies: Consumers should return the pump to the store where purchased or to the firm for a free replacement pump.
visual_product_description: White gas camping stove with an output of 10,000 BTU, no priming required, support legs and fuel bottle attached.

recall_description: Loose wires and lack of adequate grounding, presenting fire, electrocution, and shock hazards.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled light boxes and return them to the company for a refund.
visual_product_description: A white metal box containing a fluorescent light, with a Plexiglas viewing plate sliding into two black metal guides on the top, folding handle, tilt stand, and can be wall-mounted.

recall_description: The rear wheel hub may crack or wear and spin free on its axle, resulting in a loss of power to the wheel and brake, which poses the risk of injury to consumers.
remedies: Schedule a free repair of the unit.

recall_description: If batteries used in the mobile leak, the caustic liquid can seep out of the battery compartment, posing a risk of chemical burns to babies.
remedies: Providing free repair kits containing a seal for the battery compartment, which will prevent battery leakage.
visual_product_description: These are mobile crib toys that attach to the crib side rail and play music and lights that are activated by remote control. Features four star and moon characters suspended from the mobile, which turns.

recall_description: The accessory skis sold for Polaris snowmobiles could break, resulting in injury or death.
remedies: Consumers should stop using snowmobiles with the red accessory skis and bring them to a dealer for replacement.
visual_product_description: The recalled skis are red composite (nonmetallic) skis sold as an accessory item for use on snowmobiles. They have specific part numbers inscribed on the tail of the ski.

recall_description: Bottles can leak through the cap, causing cleaner to come into contact with consumers' skin and eyes, leading to irritation and burns.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled cleaners immediately and call the hotline for instructions to determine if their cleaner bottle is leaking, how to dispose of leaking bottles, and get a refund.

recall_description: Due to wear caused by the mulch fan, the mowers' blades can crack and break off. Broken pieces of the blade can be propelled from underneath the mower, possibly injuring the operator or a bystander.
remedies: Repair kits with new mower blade and modified mulching fan are provided for free and repairs can be performed by service dealers.
visual_product_description: These are 2-cycle, walk-behind, 21-inch power mowers with a decal on the right rear of the mower's housing or beneath the handle control panel. They include specific model numbers and have been sold at major retailers.

recall_description: The paint on some of the figurines contains excess levels of lead, which may present a lead poisoning hazard if ingested over time by children.
remedies: Consumers should keep the figurines away from children and contact the store to receive return and refund instructions.
visual_product_description: The bobble head figurines are 7-inch tall, designed in the likeness of NFL players with heads on springs that cause them to bobble. They are dressed in football uniforms.

recall_description: An infant can pass through the opening between the stroller tray and seat bottom, risking head and neck entrapment and strangulation.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled strollers and contact the company for a free repair kit. The stroller can continue to be used as a "travel system" where the entrapment hazard is not present.

recall_description: The serrated blade that supports the stand on a tree can bend, posing the risk of falls and serious injuries to hunters.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these treestands with specific lot numbers immediately and discard or destroy the product.
visual_product_description: The climbing tree stands have a mesh net seat and are painted green. They feature a bottom platform with serrated blades marked with certain lot numbers. Warning labels are affixed, indicating weight capacities. Model numbers include OMDX-MO, GOMDX-MO, MV-MO, and GMV-MO.

recall_description: The switches on these power tools can stick, causing them to continue operating after the trigger has been released, posing a risk of injury to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these power tools immediately and contact the tool manufacturer to receive a free replacement tool or tool repair.

recall_description: The lighters' child-resistant mechanisms are frequently ineffective, allowing young children to operate the lighters and posing a fire hazard. There have been reports of fires started by children using these lighters, leading to significant damage and a fatality.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.

recall_description: Parts from the metal inseam snaps can detach from the garment, posing a choking risk for young children.
product_name: infant and toddler garments with metal inseam snaps
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the garments away from children and contact the company for instructions on returning the garment to receive a full refund.
visual_product_description: Infant and toddler garments, including jeans, Koveralls, and Shortalls, with metal inseam snaps. Available in sizes 12-24 month and 2T to 4T for both boys and girls.

recall_description: Young children can choke on the small balls attached to these toys.
remedies: Send the toy back to the firm to receive another toy of similar value. The firm will pay postage costs.
visual_product_description: The Wiggle Waggle Caterpillar is a pull toy that plays songs and has lights. It has small balls on springs and is about 10 inches long. It is green with yellow wheels.

recall_description: The rockets' foam tips can break off exposing sharp edges that can cause face lacerations or eye injuries. The rocket systems also have weak pump handles that can break during use, posing a risk of hand lacerations.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the air rockets immediately and obtain a replacement rocket. Pump with specific warning label excluded from this recall.
visual_product_description: Contains two blue rockets with yellow foam tips, recommended for children 8 years of age and older. Includes a pump with the warning label excluded from recall.

recall_description: The ends of the blades on these riding mowers can break off and become projectiles due to metal fatigue from slots in the blades.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the product immediately and contact the dealer to make an appointment for free replacement of the recalled blades.
visual_product_description: Riding mowers are red with black wheels and controls. Blades are black with two slots cut near the middle of the blade.

recall_description: The lamp's bulb can become hot, presenting a risk of burn injuries to consumers and the risk of fire if the bulb comes in contact with combustible materials.
remedies: In-home consumer repair kit includes a wire bulb guard and enhanced safety instructions.
visual_product_description: The recalled lamps are 38 inches tall, have a flexible neck, and cartoon characters on the plastic shade. Some have no cartoon characters but have various colors like black, white, blue, green, yellow, red, or purple.

recall_description: The batteries can overcharge, causing them to become very hot, release smoke, and possibly catch fire.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these batteries immediately and contact the company to obtain a discount on a future purchase of a new consumer notebook or desktop computer.

recall_description: The lighters were imported without being tested for child-resistance, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the lighters immediately and dispose of them in accordance with local regulations. Refunds are provided if the black plastic case and use instructions are mailed back, along with a confirmation of disposal.
visual_product_description: The lighters have a brushed chrome finish and a black rubber slide lever to ignite the lighter. They are packaged in a black plastic case.

recall_description: The fabric, heat-sealed flowers on the front of the garments can detach after washing, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these garments immediately and return them for a refund.
visual_product_description: The recall includes two separate garments sold as sets: a lavender colored velour jumpsuit with a floral printed rib knit top, and a lavender colored French terry and velour top with printed rib knit bottom. Only jumpsuits with style numbers 516-8240 and 516-8340 and top and bottom sets with style numbers 516-8241 and 516-8341 are included. Both garments have felt fabric flowers on the front bodice. The jumpsuit has one large purple flower and two teal colored leaves on the front, while the top has one large purple flower and two small blue flowers on each side. Sold in sizes 0-3, 3-6, and 6-9 months.

recall_description: The submersible pressure gauge in the dive consoles can malfunction and display inaccurate pressure readings, leading to potential decompression sickness for divers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled consoles immediately and send the console to receive a replacement pressure gauge.
visual_product_description: The consoles are mostly gray in color with a submersible pressure gauge and have test codes on the back of the gauge.

recall_description: The two bolts that attach the handlebars can break. If the handlebars separate from the motorcycle, the rider loses steering control and can crash, posing the risk of serious injuries.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the motorcycles immediately and schedule a free repair with their local dealer.

recall_description: Five detachable hanging rattle toys have small round pegs at the top of the toys that can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
product_name: Electronic Light N' Learn activity gyms
remedies: Consumers should take these toys away from young children immediately and return the toy to the store where purchased for a refund, or follow return instructions provided by the store.
visual_product_description: A multi-colored toy that converts into three different toys, including a crib toy, a floor gym, and a musical keyboard with five buttons that produce music and light when pressed. It includes five detachable rattles in the shape of various figures such as a bear, snail, star, half-moon, and horse.

recall_description: The button covers on the toy can come off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
product_name: Round plastic baby toy with a face, teethable ears, and colored buttons
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the recalled toys away from young children and contact the company to participate in the recall
visual_product_description: Round plastic baby toy with a face on the front, red and blue 'teethable ear' on each side, and a yellow circular mirror on the back. Three colored buttons (red, green, blue) on the top to make the toy vibrate, sound music, or light up its eyes.

recall_description: The security camera's plastic mounting assembly can crack, allowing the dome and the camera to fall from the wall or ceiling, possibly injuring someone.
product_name: Security cameras with plastic mounting assembly and smoked plastic dome
remedies: Arrange for free repair of the security camera's mounting assembly
visual_product_description: Indoor video camera mounted on the wall or ceiling covered with a smoked plastic dome about 6 inches in diameter. Includes a mechanism to move the camera and a mounting assembly.

recall_description: The leg holes in the seat of the float can tear, causing children to unexpectedly fall into the water and possibly drown.
product_name: inflatable baby float with adjustable sunshade
remedies: Consumers should stop using these recalled floats immediately and contact Aqua-Leisure for a free replacement.
visual_product_description: The baby floats are blue and white circular tubes with a seat in the middle, and a detachable protective sunshade, featuring pictures of purple crabs and various colored fish along the top.

recall_description: The hitch connecting the tandem accessory to the host bicycle can fail, causing the tandem accessory to become unstable, which poses the risk of injury to riders.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these bicycle accessories immediately and contact the company for a free replacement hitch and instructions.

recall_description: The ball joints in the A-arm assembly on these vehicles can break, causing the front wheels to lose stability. Tie-rod assemblies can also break or work loose, damaging either the steering column plate end or knuckle and causing a potential crash.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the ATVs and contact a dealer to have the ball joints and tie-rod assemblies replaced free of charge.

recall_description: The beads can separate from the book cover, posing a choking hazard to young children.
product_name: Children's book with abacus-like toy attached
remedies: Consumers should immediately take these recalled books away from young children and return the books for a full refund and postage.
visual_product_description: The book is a twelve page white board book measuring 6.5-inches by 6.5-inches with a yellow plastic abacus-like toy attached to the back cover. The abacus toy has five small beads: blue, green, red, yellow, and orange that slide along a plastic track. It depicts a children's character on its cover.

recall_description: The frames of these bikes can break, causing the riders to fall and suffer injuries.
remedies: Consumers with a recalled bicycle will receive a replacement bicycle free of charge.

recall_description: The drill's switch can malfunction and overheat, posing the possibility of a fire hazard to consumers. Black & Decker has received twenty reports of melting, smoking, or fires in the drills, including two minor burn injuries.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the drill/drivers immediately, remove the battery, and contact the manufacturer to receive a free repair.
visual_product_description: The recalled 18-volt, cordless drill/drivers are orange or jade. The drill/drivers have specific model numbers and date codes. The model number is printed on the nameplate on the side of the drill and the date code is printed on the bottom of the handle where the battery is inserted.

recall_description: The vehicles' battery chargers can overheat, presenting fire and injury hazards to children.
remedies: Consumers should discontinue use of these products, and discard or destroy them.

recall_description: The buckles on the climbing sticks and tree steps can fail, posing a risk of serious injury to hunters, including cuts, sprains, bruises, and partial finger amputation.
remedies: Consumers should return the climbing sticks for a free repair and the tree steps for a free replacement by contacting the company.
visual_product_description: Gray climbing sticks with black swivel fold down foot pegs, a black strap and buckle system. Tree steps with a black strap, metal J hook, black buckle, and metal step.

recall_description: Gun cabinets with push button locks can be opened without a key, allowing unauthorized access to firearms.
remedies: Consumers should contact for a free push button replacement lock.
visual_product_description: Burgundy-colored gun cabinets that hold either 10 or 14 rifles or shotguns up to 54-inches tall, made of heavy steel, with a single key chrome-finished handle that moves a locking bar into place.

recall_description: The red plastic skis used on these 2003 model year snowmobiles could be damaged by UV light exposure. If during off-season storage, the snowmobile was stored with the skis exposed to sunlight, damage may have occurred. If UV damage has occurred, the ski may crack or break during use. If this occurs, it could lead to a loss of control that could result in severe injury or death.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these snowmobiles immediately. Registered owners have been notified. Consumers should contact their local snowmobile dealer to schedule the free repair.

recall_description: plastic snaps can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children
remedies: Cut off the lid of the box with the snaps and throw away the box. Send the lid to receive a free replacement book set and a refund for postage.
visual_product_description: children's characters on the front of the box, a colored plastic handle, and plastic snaps

recall_description: risk of injury from pinching or cutting fingers in the folding mechanism
remedies: order a free repair kit to prevent the frame from folding
visual_product_description: white metal folding frame, blue and white print fabric with stars, swirls, and hearts

recall_description: The nose of the stuffed bear can be pulled or twisted off, posing a choking hazard to a young child.
remedies: Consumers should return the stuffed bears to any store for exchange with another item of equal value or a gift card.
visual_product_description: The stuffed bear is about 18 to 19 inches long, made of chocolate brown material with cream-colored paws and snout, and originally had a cardboard tag attached to the ear.

recall_description: The toy includes a fabric-filled mobile phone that can pose a choking hazard to young children.
product_name: Activity toy with a detachable backpack and fabric-filled mobile phone
remedies: Consumers should take these toys away from children immediately and contact for a refund or replacement toy.
visual_product_description: Curious George monkey plush toys dressed in a yellow plastic space suit with matching gloves. They have a detachable backpack with a red fabric-filled mobile phone attached. The small mobile phone is 1.25-inches by 1.5-inches, and is connected to a gray, mesh backpack by a 4.75-inch string sewn into one of the backpack's seams.

recall_description: The hood latch can damage the fuel tank and cause fuel to leak when the hood is raised and lowered, presenting a fire and explosion hazard.
remedies: Consumers will receive a replacement hood latch and fuel tank inspection instructions.
visual_product_description: Red and gray two tone lawn and garden tractors, year 2000 models, with 42, 46 or 50-inch mower decks, 16 to 25 horsepower engines, foot pedal speed control, with optional snowplow blade attachment.

recall_description: The handles on the base of the slow cookers can break, posing a risk of burns from hot contents spilling onto consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the product and contact the manufacturer to receive instructions on receiving a replacement base.
visual_product_description: The slow cooker has a removable ceramic bowl inside a metal base. The bases are round or oval in shape and were sold in various colors and designs. The model number is located on the bottom of the base.

recall_description: The latches on the lower sash of the window can unexpectedly open, posing a potential injury hazard to consumers who can be struck by the window or by shattered glass.
remedies: In-home repair of window latches by a service technician.

recall_description: The drill's switch can malfunction and overheat, posing the possibility of a fire hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using their drill/drivers immediately, remove the battery, and contact the company to arrange for a free repair.
visual_product_description: The recalled cordless drill/drivers are orange and bear the word 'Firestorm' or jade and bear the words 'Quantum Pro.' They come with specific model numbers and date codes located on the name plate on the side of the drill and the bottom of the handle where the battery is inserted.

recall_description: Plastic pieces from the pull string connector can detach and pose a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately cut the plastic string connector off the toys or return them for a free replacement without the plastic connector.
visual_product_description: A green caterpillar pull toy, about 12 inches long, with four wheels. It has 26 plastic legs corresponding to each letter of the alphabet. The toy sings the ABC Song when pulled, features color and letter name identification, letter sounds, and lights up antennae.

recall_description: The ballast in these lamps can overheat, short-circuit, and melt the insulating cover of the ballast, causing the lamp to fail and posing a skin burn hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should unplug the lamps and stop using them immediately. Contact the company to return the lamp and receive a replacement lamp. The company will extend the warranty on the replacement lamps for 3 years from the date of replacement.

recall_description: The front fork assembly on these mini-bicycles can loosen or break, and cause the rider to lose control and crash.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these mini-bicycles immediately and return them to the place of purchase for a refund or to receive a replacement mini-bicycle.
visual_product_description: The mini-bicycle is yellow with 8-inch black rubber tires, black seat and black handgrips. The mini-bicycle is about 31-inches long and 23-inches high.

recall_description: inaccurate calculation of desaturation times by the software, leading to possible decompression sickness
remedies: Consumers should stop using these dive computers immediately and contact the company for a free replacement with the current model.
visual_product_description: blue and black dive computer with display and buttons

recall_description: The motor drive can overheat and cause the liquid contents to become hot, posing a risk of burns if the dispenser's nozzle breaks.
remedies: Owners should discontinue use, and a customer service representative will repair the product free of charge or provide a modification and instruction kit.
visual_product_description: This recall includes frozen carbonate beverage dispensers with two or four dispensing valves. They come in various color combinations.

recall_description: A malfunctioning circuit board can cause the gas pool heaters to fail to ignite, allowing gas to accumulate in the heater cover. Delayed ignition of built-up gas can result in a fire or explosion causing property damage and injuries.
remedies: Consumers should shut off the pool heater by switching off the corresponding circuit breaker and contact the company to schedule the installation of a free replacement control module.

recall_description: The bats can separate during a swing. Broken pieces can hit a bystander and cause injury.
product_name: Baseball video game set with electronic home plate, ball, and plastic bat
remedies: Consumers should immediately take these recalled toys away from children and contact the company to arrange for the return of the product to receive a replacement.
visual_product_description: Video game that simulates hitting a baseball. Includes an electronic home plate, ball, and plastic bat. User interfaces with the game using a bat swing action communicated to the television.

recall_description: The steering wheel can break away from its base, allowing the small plastic turn signal and horn pieces to come off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
product_name: Toy Steering Wheel Attachments for Strollers
remedies: Consumers should remove the toy steering wheel from these strollers and contact the manufacturer to receive a free replacement toy steering wheel.
visual_product_description: The toy steering wheel was sold on a stroller model with a sticker located on one of the rear legs, containing model number and "MADE IN CHINA" information. "Jeep" is written with yellow, raised lettering on the front of the steering wheel base.

recall_description: These units can overheat and catch fire. Whirlpool has received seven reports of fires involving these microwave-hood combinations, resulting in extensive property damage. No injuries have been reported.
remedies: Consumers with recalled microwave-hood combinations should immediately stop using them, disconnect the units by unplugging them, and can call for a free repair. The company developed an in-home service repair pamphlet with detailed information on the cause of the fires and the repair process.

recall_description: The ball joints on the front suspension of these ATVs can fail, resulting in a loss of control. This can cause the ATV to overturn, posing a risk of serious injury or death to riders.
remedies: Consumers with a recalled ATV should contact their local dealer to schedule the free repair.
visual_product_description: The recalled 2002 model ATVs are either red or green. They have the model name located on the front just below the speedometer.

recall_description: If the hardware used to assemble the crib is not tight, the mattress support platform and mattress can fall to the floor, posing a risk of injury to young children in the crib.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these portable wood cribs immediately and call a hotline anytime for a free upgrade kit that provides additional support for the mattress platform.
visual_product_description: The cribs are made of wood and are smaller than traditional baby cribs.

recall_description: A metal "j" hook on the guardrails can become dislodged, allowing the guardrail to slide or move out of position. This can allow the guardrail to detach from the bunk bed or allow the occupant to roll off the top bunk.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the top bunk if a "j" hook has become dislodged and are provided free repair kits to secure the guardrails properly.

recall_description: The high chairs have a space between the armrest and backrest in which a child's head or arm can become entrapped, posing a risk of suffocation or injury to the heads or arms of young children.
remedies: Consumers should contact the company to receive free replacement armrests that will eliminate the entrapment hazard.
visual_product_description: The high chairs have seats that can be raised or lowered, and a lever on the back of the chair that allows the seat to be tilted back. The models are 'Prima Pappa,' 'Roller,' and 'Martinelli Pappa and Nanna.' A sticker on the brace connecting the front leg to the back leg reads in part, 'Made in Italy.'

recall_description: The larger-sized ball halves can become stuck on a young child's face, covering the nose and mouth, and causing suffocation.
remedies: Parents and caregivers should take these balls away from young children immediately and return the toys to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: Five multi-colored and various-sized plastic balls that can be taken apart to be stacked on top of each other or placed inside each other.

recall_description:
Hot water and steam can escape from the steam cleaner's handle and inner hose, posing a burn hazard.
The internal hose connected to the trigger in the handle can detach, allowing hot water and/or steam to escape, posing a burn hazard to consumers.
remedies:
Stop using the steam cleaner and contact the manufacturer for information on how to return the product for a replacement or refund.
Consumers should stop using the steam cleaners immediately and contact customer service for information on how to ship the recalled product and get a replacement or refund. The company will pay for all shipping charges to return the product.
visual_product_description:
The steam cleaner is blue plastic, measures about 12-inches long and 8-inches high with a 5.5-foot steam hose and is sold with various cleaning attachments.
The steam cleaner is blue plastic and measures about 12 inches long and 8 inches high. It has a 5.5-foot black steam hose connected to the water reservoir and comes with various cleaning attachments.

recall_description: The wheel can separate from these trailers during use, and result in crashes and injuries to children riding inside. Loss of control to the bicycle pulling these trailers also can cause the riders to crash and suffer injuries.
remedies: Stop using these trailers immediately, and return them to the store where purchased for a free inspection and repair, if needed.
visual_product_description: The trailers are designed to carry two children. They are 34 inches long, 26 inches wide and 33 inches high with a weight capacity of 100 pounds.

recall_description: The nightlights can short-circuit, posing shock and burn hazards to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these lights immediately, remove them from the wall socket, and return them for a full refund or a replacement nightlight of equal value. Shipping and handling fees will be reimbursed.
visual_product_description: Electroluminescent nightlights available in gray color; model GN172 is about 1 1/2 inches square by 1/4 inch thick with two metal electrical prongs, and model GN165 is about 4-3/8 inches in height, 1-5/8 inches wide and 1/4 inch thick with two metal electrical prongs.

recall_description: Possibility of misassembly causing the seat and baby to flip forward, risking injury.
remedies: Consumers are advised to stop using the swing and inspect the seat. If improperly attached, a replacement seat and revised instructions will be provided.
visual_product_description: Indoor infant swing with sound sensor, music, metal legs (blue or beige), and seat (beige or white). Intended for use from birth until baby can sit up unassisted.

recall_description: The power cord insulation can tear where the cord attaches to the vacuum, exposing bare wires. This poses a risk of shock and burns to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should contact the company to arrange for a free repair through authorized service centers, as the vacuums cannot be repaired by retailers.
visual_product_description: The PowerClean vacuum has model number 3540-1 and is black. The PureAir vacuum has model number 3540-2 and is blue. The PureAir Deluxe vacuum has model number 3541 and is purple. The PureAir Platinum vacuum has model number 3541-P and is purple. The recalled vacuums do not have a 3-inch plastic flex relief where the power cord enters the vacuum handle.

recall_description: The pans can explode or separate when preheated, used on high heat, or used for frying, posing a serious burn hazard.
remedies: Consumers will receive information about the recall and a free replacement pan. No return of the recalled pans is needed.
visual_product_description: The pans include various sizes with stainless steel exterior and black, non-stick coated inner surface. They have various handle configurations and lids.

recall_description: The compression rods inside these forks can break, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall, and possibly suffer serious injuries.
remedies: Consumers should stop using bicycles with the recalled forks immediately and return them to the dealer where purchased for inspection and repair if needed.

recall_description: The slats on the cribs can loosen and detach from the drop side rail, creating a large opening between the slats where a child's head or neck could become entrapped, resulting in serious injury or death.
remedies: Consumers are provided with replacement drop side rails and advised to stop using the cribs until repair is performed.
visual_product_description: The cribs include models such as 7010 Alpine and are solid maple, available in finishes like natural, colonial, white, cherry, and cinnamon.

recall_description: The toy's brightly colored end knobs can detach, allowing small, geometric-shaped pieces to come loose, posing a choking hazard to infants and young children.
product_name: Klackeroo toy with colored knobs and geometric shapes
remedies: Replace the toy with a redesigned version that has no sliding geometric shapes.
visual_product_description: Brightly colored toy with orange plastic rods, small geometric shapes, and a center purple ball, with solid-colored knobs featuring animal faces or the sun and moon imprinted on them.

recall_description: Swing chains can break, causing swing seats to fall
remedies: Consumers should stop using the swings, and contact the company to determine if chains are defective. Remove and return defective chains for free replacement chains.
visual_product_description: Play sets made with redwood featuring swings, slides, rope ladders, forts, castles, and fire poles

recall_description: Burners could produce excess carbon monoxide (CO), posing a risk of CO poisoning to consumers
remedies: Replace the gas burners in the recalled water heaters
visual_product_description: Natural gas water heaters available in short and tall profiles with 30, 40, 50, and 75-gallon capacities

recall_description: Damage to the fuel tank grommet can cause a fuel leak, posing a serious fire hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these ATVs immediately. A free repair will be arranged from an authorized service center.

recall_description: These testers can short out at high voltages, causing burns.
remedies: Free replacement tester provided upon contact.
visual_product_description: These are voltage and voltage/continuity testers with model numbers 61-065, 61-066, 61-067, 61-076, 61-079, and 61-080. The body is yellow with black and red test probes.

recall_description: The clips holding the control cable to the handle may be missing, which could cause the blade control device to fail and keep the mower blade running when it should stop. If the blade control device fails, consumers could suffer serious injuries.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these lawn mowers immediately, and take them to a service center for a free repair.
visual_product_description: The recalled cordless electric lawn mowers have an orange deck and a charcoal black motor cover. The reconditioned lawn mowers have the model number CMM1000R and specific date codes, located on a silver and black label on the rear door of the mower. They have the words "Cordless" on top of the motor cover.

recall_description: These gas valves could stick in the open position allowing gas to flow freely, which poses a risk of serious injury to consumers from fire and explosion during an earthquake. This recall is being conducted to prevent the possibility of injuries.
remedies: Consumers should contact the company immediately to have their shut-off valve replaced free of charge.
visual_product_description: The recalled Earthquake Valves are about 3-1/2 inches wide by 2-1/2 inches high by 2 inches deep. The valves' bodies are made of aluminum and are coated with a blue color. The recalled valves have a white reset knob in the front that reads, "Valve" and a white label on the back that reads in part, "Models, ASCE, RR#, CSA-OSA, 2 PSI Max Gas Flow."

recall_description: If the capacitors short circuit due to a very high electrical surge, such as from a lightning strike, the metal parts on the television could present a shock or electrocution hazard.
remedies: Consumers who have an affected television will receive a free replacement, which includes removal of the recalled television, delivery and installation of the replacement.

recall_description: The wrenches have power cords that can release from the handle, posing an injury or electrocution hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these electric wrenches immediately and return them to the nearest factory service center or authorized power tool service center for a free repair.
visual_product_description: Impact wrenches shaped like drills, with a forward/reverse (impact) action to tighten/loosen bolts, a red handle, a red and gray body, and model numbers on the nameplate.

recall_description: The swing arm, part of the rear suspension, can loosen and fall out, causing loss of drivetrain power and possible loss of vehicle control
remedies: Consumers should stop using these vehicles immediately and contact their local dealer to schedule an appointment for a free repair.

recall_description: The lighters lack child-resistant mechanisms that meet federal safety standards. Young children could operate these lighters, which poses a fire hazard.
remedies: Contact for instructions on obtaining a refund. Dispose of the lighters according to state and local requirements. Do not incinerate or puncture.
visual_product_description: Refillable, gas-fueled lighters shaped like a wooden match. Brushed, silver-colored metal finish with a black plastic slide lever for ignition. The end is painted red to resemble a match head. Available in 7-inch and 14-inch lengths. Sold without labeling in a clear plastic sleeve.

recall_description: The steer tube on the front of the bicycles can break off from the two main tubes of the frame leading to loss of control and potential injury.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled bikes immediately and contact the distributor to learn where to have the frames replaced free of charge.
visual_product_description: 11.5-inch frames with model names: Bobcat Trail, Hawk Hill, Palisades Trail, Pioneer Trail, Nail Trail, Stinson and Rocky Ridge. 13.5-inch model name: Quake. Model name is on top tube, frame size from center of crank arm to 1 inch below seatpost clamp.

recall_description: The basketball hoops can have a sharp protruding bolt on the player's side of the pole that can cause serious leg or body lacerations.
remedies: Consumers should examine their units immediately and contact the company to receive free bolt covers.
visual_product_description: Portable, vertically mounted basketball system with a plastic base weighted down by sand or water, basketball poles painted black.

recall_description: Delayed ignition flashback fire in the upper oven, posing a fire and burn hazard.
product_name: Gas range with upper and lower ovens
remedies: Stop using the upper oven self-clean and broil features until a free in-home repair is conducted.
visual_product_description: Freestanding gas range with separate upper and lower ovens, available in various colors including white, black, bisque, and stainless finish.

recall_description: The fuel tank seam can split or crack, leaking fuel and creating a fire and burn hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these lawnmowers immediately, check for gas tank leaks, and take them to a power equipment dealer for inspection and free fuel tank replacement.
visual_product_description: Dark gray lawnmowers with red fan covers, 'Harmony II' and model numbers HRT216, HRR216, and HRS216 written on the front, and serial numbers between 1128495 and 1438098.

recall_description: The plastic handles can detach and cause consumers to lose their grip, resulting in injuries to the eyes and face.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these eyelash curlers immediately and return the eyelash curler for a free replacement plus a $5 off coupon towards any product.
visual_product_description: The 'Frosted Grip' eyelash curlers have pink-plastic handles and are sold with a rubber re-fill pad. The eyelash curlers were sold under various brand names including TRIM and Salon Plus.

recall_description: The throttles on these ATVs can stick, preventing the ATV from slowing down when released. This can cause the vehicle to lose control and crash, resulting in severe injury or death.
remedies: Contact the dealer to schedule a free vehicle repair to address the throttle issue.

recall_description: The lock mechanisms on both sides of the stroller can break and create a pinch-point hazard, injuring young children.
remedies: Free repair kit is offered to affected consumers.
visual_product_description: The strollers have a reversible handle that allows pushing while facing or from behind the child, a footrest with a 'Ranger' or 'Ranger Quattro' sticker, and a safety belt harness with a brand sewn into it. They have different side-lock mechanisms in recalled models made from December 1999 to June 2000.

recall_description: screws that hold the swing together can fall out, causing the seat to fall to the ground, posing an injury risk to children
product_name: rocket rider swing on backyard gym set
remedies: Consumers should stop using the swings immediately, detach them from the gym set, and discard or destroy them.

recall_description: The dog puzzle included with the products and the rubber handle on the box of the activity set can tear apart into small pieces and pose a choking hazard to small children.
remedies: Consumers should take these toys away from children immediately and contact the company for free replacement pieces.
visual_product_description: The "Toddler Tote" travel activity sets contain three animal puzzles, seven stacker pegs of various colors, a geometric shapes puzzle and four basic shape mini-puzzles in a blue box with a rubber handle. The puzzle set called "Familiar Things" includes 12 two-piece puzzles with cut-outs of fish, planes, boats, and cars, packaged in a purple box.

recall_description: The gel candle can melt the plastic candleholders included with the kit, posing a fire hazard to consumers. CPSC has received reports of plastic candleholders melting and starting fires, causing damage and injuries.
remedies: Stop using these candles immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: Gel Candles kit includes four bags of gel chips in bright colors, wicks, glitter, two glass holders, and two plastic candleholders in shapes of a bumblebee and a dragonfly, or a tulip and a daisy. The gel is scented in fruit flavors.

recall_description: A rung on these aluminum, multi-purpose ladders can release or the side rail can bend unexpectedly. If that happens, the ladder can collapse, causing the user to fall. One incident reported involved a fractured leg.
remedies: Notifying consumers to return the ladders for a refund.

recall_description: The plastic tabs on the playpen that lock the rails into the corners can break or loosen over time, allowing the rails to turn inward, collapse and entrap an infant.
remedies: Stop using these playpens immediately and contact the manufacturer to receive a refund or replacement product.
visual_product_description: 28-inch by 40-inch playpens with four mesh sides on a folding metal frame and side rails. The padded floorboard forms a carrying case for the playpen.

recall_description: Extreme vibration can occur within these CDX regulators, which can cause an air leakage underwater. Divers could run out of air and drown.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled CDX regulators immediately and take them to any authorized dealer to get a free repair. Other repairs or normal maintenance performed in addition to the recall repair will incur a charge.

recall_description: These blankets can overheat, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers, especially when the blanket is folded or bunched.
remedies: Firm is providing a free replacement blanket. Consumers should unplug the recalled units immediately.
visual_product_description: Electric blankets sold in king, queen, full, and twin sizes, available in ivory, light blue, and hunter green colors. The blankets have a UL warning label and a permanent label that reads 'Shell Made in China. Wired and Closed in U.S.A.'

recall_description: The mouse ball can separate from the mouse and pose a choking hazard to young children.
product_name: computer mouse shaped like a toy car
remedies: Consumers are encouraged to destroy the computer mouse and can obtain an equivalent toy valued at $10 by returning the retaining ring from the bottom of the mouse.
visual_product_description: The computer mouse is shaped like a toy car, has a red body and yellow roof, and a sticker on the back shaped like a license plate that says, 'Cool Car'.

recall_description: The nozzle can be easily unscrewed, exposing the uninsulated heater coil. The heater coil's grounding screw does not sufficiently reduce the current through the water, posing an electrocution and shock hazard to the bather.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these showerhead hot water heaters immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.

recall_description: The overpressure valve can stick in the open position, posing a drowning hazard to divers.
product_name: Buoyancy Control Systems with Overpressure Valves
remedies: Contact the dealer where purchased for a free replacement of the overpressure valve.

recall_description: The electric fans have undersized wiring, use a power plug that is not polarized, overheat, and have an improperly sized grill, which could cause electrocution, electric shock, fire, and finger entrapment hazards.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the electric fans immediately and return them for a full refund.

recall_description: The antenna on the pull toy can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should take these caterpillar toys away from children immediately and send them to the company to receive a replacement toy or a refund, including the cost of postage.
visual_product_description: bright red and yellow wooden caterpillar about 7-inches long, pulled by a nylon string

recall_description: The handles on the fryer baskets can come off, resulting in hot oil spattering the user and bystanders, causing minor burns.
remedies: Consumers should stop using their deep fryer baskets immediately and contact the company to receive a free repair kit.
visual_product_description: Deep fryer baskets with silver screws attaching the basket handle, used in electric deep fryers.

recall_description: The tube attaching the fork to the bicycle can fail, causing riders to lose control and fall.
product_name: bicycle forks for BMX and mountain bikes
remedies: Consumers are advised to stop riding the bicycles and take them to an authorized dealer for a free inspection and repair.

recall_description: The blinds contain lead exceeding government guidelines and lack required labeling warning they contain lead, posing a risk of lead poisoning to children.
remedies: Consumers should remove the window blinds from windows and keep them away from children. Consumers can return the blinds to the store where they were purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: white miniblinds and woodgrain roll-up blinds, ranging from 23-inches wide by 42-inches long to 72-inches wide by 120-inches long, manufactured in Thailand for use as window coverings.

recall_description: An internal failure within the Hydrostatic Transmission preventing it from returning to neutral can allow unexpected movement or cause the tractor to continue moving, posing a risk of injury.
remedies: Stop using the tractors immediately and contact a dealer for a free repair.

recall_description: The oven cleaner's contents can spew out because of an improperly attached valve assembly that can separate from the can, posing a risk of chemical burns to consumers' skin and eyes.
remedies: Consumers should wrap the recalled can of oven cleaner in several layers of newspaper, take it outside and dispose of it with the regular household trash. The company will send consumers a replacement oven cleaner coupon.
visual_product_description: The 16-oz. aerosol cans are yellow with a solid yellow plastic cap. There are bold black letters at the top part of the can, and specific colored blocks indicating strength and type. Only cans with a specific lot number printed on the bottom are affected.

recall_description: the yellow pom-pom can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children
product_name: toy bear with nightcap and pom-pom
remedies: Consumers should immediately remove the bear's pom-pom to eliminate the choking hazard
visual_product_description: The bean bear is 5 inches tall and wears a blue nightcap with a yellow moon and star design, with a yellow pom-pom at the end.

recall_description: The juice extractor's strainer basket and lid can break apart, posing a risk of injury to nearby consumers, who can be struck by metal or plastic.
remedies: Stop using the juice extractor immediately. Consumers with certain models will receive a free replacement strainer basket. For other models, consumers will receive either a new juice extractor or a refund.
visual_product_description: White plastic juice extractor, about 12 inches in height.

recall_description: The smoke alarms can fail to alarm when smoke or fire is present. A capacitor in the alarm can burn out, releasing smoke and melting the cover. There have been reports of alarms failing, releasing smoke, and minor smoke damage.
remedies: Contact the company to receive a free replacement alarm.

recall_description: The lamp can fall out of the lamp socket and strike somebody standing or walking beneath the light fixture, posing a laceration risk if the lamp breaks.
product_name: 22 inch diameter low mount open lighting fixtures
remedies: Provision of a retention plate to be installed over the lamps to hold them in place.
visual_product_description: The light fixtures measure 22 inches in diameter, labeled 'LOW MOUNT,' with catalog numbers formatted as 'ELP-O 2 - (1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6) (1, 2, 3 or 4) 842 T-1.'

recall_description: internal electrical component could overheat when connected to 277-volt electrical systems, posing a fire hazard
remedies: Contact the company for repair kits
visual_product_description: black or off-white polycarbonate housing with two incandescent lamps, 16-inches wide, 5-inches high, and 4-inches deep

recall_description: The recumbent seats on these bicycles can crack and break, causing the seat to come off the frame and resulting in injury to the rider.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately. The firm is out of business, so remedies may not be available. Consumers can take a recalled bicycle to the dealer from which it was purchased for potential repair.

recall_description: The lower blade guards on these saws can stick in the open position, posing a risk of serious injury to the operator and bystanders.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the saws immediately and contact the company's Consumer Response Team for a free repair kit.
visual_product_description: The circular saws have a blue plastic body and a metal blade guard, with a 7 1/4-inch blade size. Some were sold in kits with a hard plastic, gray storage case.

recall_description: Loose or leaking oil cooler line clamps may release hot, pressurized oil, leading to thermal burns, engine failure, or vehicle fire.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these vehicles immediately and contact a dealer to schedule a free repair.

recall_description: The Buggy Board's red connecting pins can break, causing the board to partially detach from the stroller or carriage, posing a fall hazard to the user.
remedies: Free repair kits consisting of orange replacement pins for these stroller attachments are provided to consumers.
visual_product_description: The Lascal 'Buggy Board' is a wheeled board that attaches to a stroller or baby carriage, allowing an older child to stand on the board and ride behind the stroller between the arms of a parent or caregiver. The product comes in black, blue, red and techno styles, and has the words 'Buggy Board' printed on the top center of the board, with the name 'Lascal' molded into the plastic on the bottom center of the board. Buggy Boards with orange connecting pins are not included in the recall.

recall_description: The emergency exit signs have an internal electrical component that could overheat and fail when connected to 277-volt electrical systems and melt the enclosure, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Building managers should contact the manufacturer to request a free repair kit.
visual_product_description: These emergency exit signs have a white or black plastic housing, measure 13 1/2 inches long, 8 3/8 inches high and 2 7/8 inches deep, and feature a raised bead around the edge of the front face and a rectangular rocker switch on the bottom.

recall_description: The vehicles' battery charger or wires can overheat, presenting fire and injury hazards to children.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the vehicles and contact for a free, new charger. Consumers should not charge the vehicles or let children use the vehicles until they have received the new charger.
visual_product_description: Plastic vehicles powered by one 6-volt battery, intended for children 1-1/2 to 4 years old; speed ranges from 1 to 2 mph.

recall_description: The wiring in the lights can short, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the lights immediately and contact the dealer from whom the light fixtures were purchased to receive a free replacement fixture.
visual_product_description: The recalled ceiling-mounted light fixtures come in six different models. The white glass lights have an antique brass, polished brass, white, or brushed stainless finish and do not have any exposed screws. The light fixture is twisted into the base and locks in place.

recall_description: A frame down tube on these motorcycles can crack below the steering head, potentially resulting in failure of the frame and causing the rider to lose control and crash.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the motorcycles immediately and contact the dealer for a free inspection and repair.
visual_product_description: Small, two-wheel, off-road competition vehicles designed for rough terrain with lime green fenders and bodywork, and they can be identified by specific VIN numbers.

recall_description: improper wiring causing short circuit and inadequate insulation exposing wiring
product_name: electric scooters with seat, two wheels, and footrests
remedies: Consumers should stop using the scooters immediately and return them to the store for a full refund.
visual_product_description: The scooters have a seat, two wheels and footrests on each side. A sticker on the left footrest reads, 'E-Scooter.' On the right footrest is a sticker with a horse-head image. A serial number is printed underneath the left footrest. The affected scooter's model number is DK24250-3.

recall_description: Exploding fire extinguishers due to high-pressure contents, causing flying debris and potential injury
remedies: Consumers are advised to discharge the fire extinguishers into a plastic garbage bag or similar container outside, in an open area, and return the discharged units to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: Yellow body with black top and red spout. "Portable Liquid Fire Extinguisher," about 10 inches high and 12 ounces in weight.

recall_description: Welds on the frame of these trampolines can break during use, causing consumers to fall to the ground and suffer injuries.
remedies: Firm is out of business and a remedy is no longer available. Consumers should stop using and discard or destroy the product immediately to prevent injuries.
visual_product_description: These are 12-foot, 13-foot, and 14-foot trampolines sold separately, and also banded together with safety enclosures. Model numbers: 10136, 101366, 101442, 10146, 102369, 102949, 10321, 103217 or 10381. Four-digit date codes range from 0403 through 2103.

recall_description: The insulated bottles have a weak seal and can leak hot liquids, which poses a serious burn hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these bottles immediately and return them to the store for a full refund.
visual_product_description: 32 oz. stainless steel containers, with a black base and handle, a black carrying strap, and a two-piece lid (including a drinking cup).

recall_description: The overpressure valve can stick in the open position, presenting a drowning hazard to divers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the BCDs immediately and return them to the dive store where purchased for a free replacement.

recall_description: The eyes on the pull toy can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take these pull toys away from children and return them for a refund.
visual_product_description: A bright green, yellow and red wooden pull toy. The snail measures 10-inches long and 4-inches high and is pulled by a nylon string attached to the underside of the toy. On the snail head are two yellow protruding pegs painted black and white to depict eyeballs.

recall_description: The zipper pull could detach from these jackets, posing a possible choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Return the jacket to the store where purchased for a refund or store credit.
visual_product_description: These girls' hooded fleece jackets are made of 80 percent cotton and 20 percent polyester, available in colors such as pink, green, blue, lilac, melon, and turquoise.

recall_description: The mallet that comes as part of this table set can be lodged into the throats of young children, posing a choking hazard. Shelcore received a report of the mallet being jammed into the throat of a 13-month old boy after he fell while teething on the ball end of the mallet. Lacerations in the throat resulted when an adult had to forcibly remove the mallet to prevent choking.
product_name: Children's Play Table with xylophone mallets
remedies: Consumers should immediately throw the recalled mallets in the trash, and call the company for a free replacement mallet.
visual_product_description: The 'Stand-Up 'N Play Table' measures 14 inches long, 14 inches wide and 13 inches high. The multi-colored play table includes a telephone, clicking dial, spinner, push-button squeaker, rolling ball, spinning gears, xylophone and mallet, three colorful shapes, and a shape sorter. The tray of the table is white, and the legs are red with yellow caps at the base. Writing on the box reads, 'Ages 9-36 Months,' and 'Encourages Child to Pull-Up and Stand.'

recall_description: The UPS outputs were wired incorrectly creating a reverse polarity configuration and a potential electrical shock hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the unit and contact for a free replacement unit.
visual_product_description: Black with a silver/grey panel on the front, used to provide voltage regulation, surge suppression, and back-up power for electronic equipment. Model numbers include OmniGuard 1100, OmniGuard 1500, OmniGuard 2300, and OmniGuard 3200.

recall_description: Pieces of the candles' wick can fall off while burning and the wick can re-ignite after extinguishing, posing a fire and burn hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the candles immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a full refund. The candles can also be mailed to the company's address to receive a refund.
visual_product_description: candles with a single wick surrounded by wax in a brown coconut shell, available in about 20 different scents and ranging in sizes from 'Mini' to 'Large'. Some have moon and star cutouts around the upper rim of the coconut shell.

recall_description: The zipper pull and metal ring on the garments can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children
remedies: Consumers should immediately remove the zipper pull and the metal ring from the garments and dispose of them. Consumers can return the garments to any retail store to receive a replacement garment.
visual_product_description: 100-percent polyester girls' fleece- hooded jackets and sleeveless vests, pink or violet in color, sold in infant sizes 9-24 months and toddler sizes 2T-4T, with a zipper front, rubber zipper pull attached by a metal ring, and two pockets with flowers on them

recall_description: When pulled to open, the drinking spout on the sports cap can unexpectedly come off, posing a choking hazard for young children.
product_name: Bottled Water with Push-Pull Sports Cap
remedies: Consumers should take the bottled water with the sports cap away from children immediately and return it to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: Bottled water sold in 8 oz., 8.5 oz., and .33 liter plastic bottles with a push-pull sports cap, available as singles or multi-packs.

recall_description: The toggle, a small plastic ball attached to the laces, can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should remove the toggles and dispose of them. Boots can be returned to the store for a refund.
visual_product_description: Boys' boots in blue and black with a space scene patch; Girls' boots in white with pink and lavender trim with a snow scene patch. Sizes 6 through 10.

recall_description: The rear brakes on these motorcycles can fail, causing a rider to lose control of the vehicle and crash, resulting in injuries or death.
remedies: A repair kit will be provided for free, and owners can either repair it themselves or take the motorcycle to a dealership for a free repair.
visual_product_description: The motorcycles are designed for motocross competitions, featuring a green color with the frame near the steering column and model number on the frame from the rear tire to the braking system.

recall_description: Electric shock or fire possible because the internal grounding conductor may not be properly secured to the receptacle.
product_name: Heavy Duty Portable Industrial Cord Reels
remedies: Consumers should stop using the product immediately and call the company to obtain a refund. The company is contacting affected consumers directly via mail where contact info is known.
visual_product_description: The recalled heavy-duty portable industrial cord reels are yellow with a carrying handle, extendable/retractable extension cord, and 6 electrical outlets/plugs. The units are marked 'Cord Reel Portable Power' and sold as 'SKU 42053.' The label on the rear of the unit contains the following information: 'Cord Reel, 10 Amps, 125 Volts, 1250 Watts, Caution, Disconnect all plugs inserted into the outlets on this face before winding cord reel in either direction, Made in Taiwan, R.O.C.'

recall_description: The seat of these devices can collapse, causing the consumer to fall to the ground and suffer injury.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled treestands and treeseats immediately, and contact the company for a free repair.

recall_description: The product may have been misassembled during manufacture, which could pose a risk of fire.
product_name: Extra Outlet PlugIns Scented Oil electric air fresheners
remedies: Consumers should immediately unplug the air fresheners and contact the company for free, full value replacement coupons or a refund.

recall_description: The rockets can fly rapidly in unpredictable directions, potentially hitting and injuring children. Reports include rockets striking children, with one incident of a head injury.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled water rocket toys immediately and call the company to receive a replacement.
visual_product_description: The rockets have a transparent blue plastic body with a red soft foam nose and blue or yellow rocket fins. Each rocket comes with a color coordinated launcher that attaches to a garden hose. The rocket is powered by water and air.

recall_description: A child could fall from a carrier when the seat restraint strap is not doubled-back through the slider if the carrier's safety harness is not used. The seat restraint strap is located between the child's legs when the child is seated.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these carriers immediately and contact the company to receive instructions on doubling back the strap through the slider.

recall_description: Overheating or flashbacks under the control panel can cause flames to damage the gas supply hose and user's hands, leading to burns.
remedies: Consumers should discard or destroy the product as remedy is no longer available.
visual_product_description: 36,000 BTU 450-square-inch grills with dark blue lid, black plastic side shelves, and a black frame and front panel.

recall_description: Small, decorative items on the garments can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these garments and sandals immediately and return them to the store where purchased to receive a refund.
visual_product_description: The recall involves three separate garment sets, including newborn and infant dresses with sandals, and an infant capri set with sandals. The dresses were available in red and yellow or chambray, featuring decorative items like ladybugs and flowers. The capri sets were available in lime, coral, yellow, and purple with flower attachments around the neckline and on the sandals.

recall_description: Children can get entangled and strangle in the hood drawstrings that catch on objects.
remedies: Remove the drawstring from the garments immediately or return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: Navy blue long-sleeve hooded sweatshirts in pullover and zip-up front styles, sold in sizes 2T through 12.

recall_description: The center column can break, causing a child to suddenly fall backward or be hit in the face by the broken column. This defect has resulted in 1,427 reports of breakage and five injuries, including bumps on heads, cut faces, and split lips, with two children requiring stitches.
remedies: Consumers should take these spinning ride toys away from children immediately and discard or destroy the products. The firm is out of business and a replacement toy is no longer available.
visual_product_description: A purple turntable with a green column through the middle, topped by a yellow steering wheel. The child sits on the turntable and spins around by turning the steering wheel. The toy plays five songs and lights flash while the child is spinning.

recall_description: A manufacturing defect inside the charger can cause overheating of internal connections or external wiring, presenting a fire hazard. Chargetek has received three reports of fires involving the CT-2000.
product_name: battery chargers used with recreational vehicles, such as boats
remedies: Stop using and disconnect the AC power and the batteries from the chargers immediately to arrange for a free replacement
visual_product_description: The words 'CT2000' are printed across the front of the charger's black housing. Indicator lights for charge mode, battery polarity and charge current are located on the front. Wires for the AC power and three batteries extend from the bottom of the unit.

recall_description: Some of the legs on these chairs were mis-assembled by the installer and a piece of the chair could be bent out of shape. This can allow the chair to collapse during use causing consumers to suffer injuries from falls.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the folding chairs immediately and return them to the place where purchased to receive a replacement chair or a refund.

recall_description: The plastic housing on these units can detach, posing a shock hazard. NETGEAR has received one report from a consumer of a detached casing. No injuries were reported.
remedies: Consumers should remove electrical power source to the receptacle and unplug the unit. Contact the company for a free repair kit to ensure that the plastic housing will not become loose or separated.
visual_product_description: The Wall Plug Ethernet Bridge is used to extend internet availability throughout a home or business. It is 2.75 inches high, 3.5 inches wide, and 2 inches thick, with a grayish silver plastic housing. The plastic housing contains a label with the model number and the serial number on it.

recall_description: The power supply, if overloaded, can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
product_name: DC power supply units for controls
remedies: Consumers should contact the manufacturer to receive a free replacement power supply unit.
visual_product_description: Recalled 12-volt DC power supply units sold as accessory power supply device for wall stations and control interfaces. Black plastic with model number imprinted on the plug side and blue and white label on opposite side.

recall_description: The mounting-bracket weld on the rear hub can come loose, resulting in rear brake failure and possible injury to operators. There have been reports of such weld problems with the mounting brackets, and in some cases leading to loss of rear brakes and an injury.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the ATVs immediately and call their local dealer to schedule a free inspection and repair if needed.

recall_description: The top piece of glass that supports the fondue pot can shatter, posing a burn and laceration hazard.
remedies: Stop using the recalled fondue pot and contact the firm for a replacement wire frame stand that replaces the glass stand.
visual_product_description: fondue sets including Modern Set in White, Black, or Stainless, and Classic Set in White or Black with glass stands

recall_description: The front column of the scooter does not meet impact resistance standards, causing the handlebar column to potentially break if the scooter hits an object, leading to a risk of falling and injury.
remedies: Consumers should return the three-wheeled scooters to any dealership or contact the firm for information on returning the scooter to receive a refund. Additionally, consumers will receive a gift certificate for merchandise.
visual_product_description: The SlideCarver is a three-wheeled scooter designed for steering both in the front and back, with twin-disc brakes and wide tires with wear indicators. It stands 39.5 inches high by 20 inches wide, with a 26.5-inch wheelbase, weighs approximately 26.5 pounds, and can be folded.

recall_description: Cables on the treestand can break, causing it to fall and pose an injury hazard.
