remedies: Consumers should stop using the treestands immediately and contact the company for a free repair.
visual_product_description: The recalled treestands weigh between 16 and 22 lbs., are made of aluminum and steel, and have a platform and padded seat cushion. They are used by hunters to provide an elevated view of potential game.

recall_description: The grinder's switch can stick in the 'on' position, which could pose an injury hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the grinders immediately and return them to their nearest factory service center or authorized power tool service center for a free repair.

recall_description: The top half of the seat inserts can separate, causing a child to fall and potentially be injured.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the seats immediately and contact the company to receive a free repair kit with instructions.
visual_product_description: Booster seat made of blue plastic with green and red arms, and includes a yellow feeding tray. The seat insert is made up of two halves that are 'press-fitted' together with a smooth surface bottom. Includes a restraint system with a two-piece waist strap and one crotch strap.

recall_description: The SCUBA BC bladder can have a slow leak because of imperfections within the machining of the stainless air barrel of their inflators. This can cause unexpected buoyancy problems with divers, possibly resulting in decompression sickness.
product_name: Scuba Buoyancy Compensator stainless steel power inflators
remedies: Stop using immediately and receive a free repair from the manufacturer.
visual_product_description: Stainless steel oral and power inflate button. The BCs sold with these inflators are black.

recall_description: The lights have undersized wiring and lack over-current protection, posing electrocution and electric shock hazards to consumers and also creating fire hazards.
product_name: Five-way Flasher Miniature Lights Christmas light sets
remedies: Consumers should stop using the Christmas lights immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: Miniature Christmas lights with 100 lights on each string of various colors, and a plug with '125V-3A' imprinted. The packaging is a red box with a photo of a Christmas tree and writings like 'JUEGO DE LUCES DE NAVIDAD,' '100 MINIATURE LIGHTS,' 'FIVE-WAY FLASHER,' 'PRE-TESTED,' and 'ENERGY SAVER.'

recall_description: The handles on these exercise machines can detach during use and the cable attached to the handles can break, resulting in injury to the user.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these exercisers immediately and contact the manufacturer to order a free repair kit.

recall_description: A software problem can result in system devices unexpectedly changing their Type ID, making them appear to be photo detectors. This condition should result in several trouble signals. If the problem is not corrected, the system will not operate as programmed and will not provide the expected level of protection.
remedies: Upgraded CPU firmware set will be provided at no charge to address the issue.

recall_description: The strap mounting bracket can loosen or rotate, causing the strap hook to release and the tree stand to detach from the tree, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should contact the firm to receive free replacement hardware for self-installation.
visual_product_description: "hang-on" stands with dual post seat uprights and a gold-colored strap hook bracket, identified by a yellow warning label that reads "Hunting Products." Only models with the gold-colored bracket are included.

recall_description: The futon may fail cigarette ignition resistance tests due to uneven distribution of boric acid flame retardant, potentially resulting in burn injuries.
remedies: Consumers can obtain a free replacement futon by calling the company.

recall_description: Snaps on these overalls can detach from the garments, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using these overalls, and return them for a refund.
visual_product_description: Two styles of overalls: Traditional blue denim with full snap crotch, bib pocket, front and back pockets, sewn-in label "0DB48". Sizes 6 months through 4T. Lined woodland cotton twill with red check flannel, full snap crotch, front zipper, a small pocket on the left front, rear pockets, applique of bear and pine tree, sewn-in label "0HS39". Sizes 6 months through 3T.

recall_description: The adapters can overheat and melt a hole through the housing, posing a fire hazard. In addition, the exposed wires pose a shock hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the power adapters immediately and contact the manufacturer to receive a free replacement.
visual_product_description: The recall involves black AC power adapters with part number '34-0949-02' used to connect ADSL routers to electrical outlets. These adapters are integral for high-speed Internet access in various work environments.

recall_description: The hairdryers do not have an immersion protection device on the power cord and could present a serious electrocution hazard if exposed to water.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the hairdryers immediately and return them for a free replacement unit with an immersion protection device.
visual_product_description: The recalled hairdryers are pistol-shaped, have the model number BAB2002BLX, rated at 1875 watts, with 'FOR PROFESSIONAL USE ONLY' tag, and lack ALCI or GFCI device.

recall_description: The tank in the lawn tractor can crack and leak fuel, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these lawn tractors immediately and contact the appropriate service center for a free repair.
visual_product_description: Picture of Recalled Tractor

recall_description: The amplifier can overheat due to a lack of ventilation, which can cause melting of the plastic front cover and pose a shock hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should unplug the units immediately and contact the company for information on how to receive a free repair.
visual_product_description: Silver amplifiers about 17 inches wide, 16 inches deep, and 5 inches high.

recall_description: The wooden bench may collapse because not enough glue was used during assembly.
remedies: Stop using the recalled benches immediately and contact your local dealer or the company for a repair appointment.
visual_product_description: The wooden organ bench measures 26 inches high, 12 inches wide, and 48 inches long. The benches are made of oak, red oak, and walnut colored wood.

recall_description: These paper shredders do not have a protective shield to guard against exposure to the cutting blades, risking cuts or amputations.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the paper shredders and can receive a replacement or refund.
visual_product_description: These shredders are light gray, labeled with '75X Cross Cut', and 'MADE IN CHINA' at the bottom.

recall_description: The grills can be difficult or impossible to turn off and the temperature control can malfunction, posing fire, burn, and explosion hazards.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the grills immediately, and return them to the store for a full refund with additional compensation.
visual_product_description: The grill is made of rust-resistant stainless steel and folds like a suitcase, with built-in handles. It measures 23 inches long by 8 inches high with a 20,000-BTU propane-gas burner with adjustable temperature controls.

recall_description: Under certain operating conditions, particularly when the batteries are near the end of charge, some transporters may not deliver enough power, allowing the rider to fall. This can happen if the rider speeds up abruptly, encounters an obstacle, or continues to ride after receiving a low-battery alert.
remedies: Contact the manufacturer toll-free for information on how to receive a free software upgrade. Riders are reminded that appropriate operating techniques as described in user materials are essential to safety.

recall_description: These bicycle helmets fail impact testing and labeling required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets, violating the Consumer Product Safety Act. Riders wearing these helmets are not properly protected from falls, and could suffer severe head injuries.
remedies: Consumers should stop wearing these bicycle helmets immediately, and return them to Rand International for a free replacement helmet.
visual_product_description: Various models of the L.A. Cruisin' bicycle helmets in child, youth, and adult sizes. Youth and adult sizes are white or black, and child sizes are blue or pink. A label inside the helmet reads 'Manufactured by Rand International,' and 'MADE IN CHINA.' The packaging reads, 'RAND,' 'L.A. Cruisin',' and 'Meets CPSC & ASTM Standards78.'

recall_description: The 1.5-inch to 1.75-inch rubber tab at the top of the heel can detach from the shoe, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the recalled shoes away from young children and contact the company to receive a refund voucher.
visual_product_description: The children's athletic shoes come in various color combinations and were sold in toddler and pre-school sizes 2C through 3Y. All shoes close with a strap. The style name is written on the shoe box. The recalled shoes have one of the following six-digit numbers on a label inside the shoe just above the UPC code: 308638, 308639, 308642 and 308647.

recall_description: The lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms, as required by federal law. Young children could ignite the lighters, presenting fire and burn hazards.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.

recall_description: The motor in the circulating pump can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the spas immediately and contact the service center to arrange for installation of a free replacement pump capacitor.
visual_product_description: The spas have an acrylic liner with western red cedar siding and seat up to six adults.

recall_description: The fuel tank vents on these products can leak, posing a fire hazard. Tanaka and CPSC have received one report of a hedge trimmer catching fire and causing minor damage. No injuries have been reported.
remedies: Consumers should stop using it immediately and return it to any authorized service dealer for a free repair. The equipment will be fitted with a redesigned fuel tank.
visual_product_description: The products are orange with black handles and have model numbers printed on the recoil starter cover. The serial number is located on a label on the side of the engine.

recall_description: The bar ends can crack when tightened and come loose during use, which can cause riders to lose control of the bicycle and potentially suffer injuries.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the bar ends immediately and return them for a replacement or refund.

recall_description: The heating element on these baths can fail to shut off, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should disconnect the electrical supply to their bath by unplugging the equipment or by switching off the circuit breaker immediately, and schedule an appointment for a free repair.

recall_description: Some propane cylinders were overfilled, which can cause them to release flammable propane gas unexpectedly, posing a risk of fires and explosions.
remedies: Consumers should not use gas grills or other appliances with these cylinders and should not disconnect or transport the cylinder. They should call the toll-free hotline for instructions on getting their gas cylinder inspected and replaced if needed.
visual_product_description: A white gas grill cylinder with a shrink-wrapped sleeve around it.

recall_description: defective Start/RER switch potentially causing accidental operation and engine restarting issues
remedies: Contact authorized dealer for switch replacement
visual_product_description: 2-tone blue or all black snowmobiles with Rotax 4-TEC V-1000 or Rotax 2-TEC 800 SDI engines

recall_description: These hair dryers do not have an immersion protection device or ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) on the power cord, posing a serious electrocution hazard if dropped in water.
remedies: Stop using these hair dryers immediately and return to the firm for a replacement unit that has an immersion protection device.
visual_product_description: The recalled units are electric hand held hair dryers with a pistol grip, black or red colored plastic casing, and a two-prong power cord.

recall_description: These pacifiers fail federal safety tests, come apart, and can pose a choking hazard to infants and small children.
remedies: Return the pacifiers to the store where purchased for a full refund.
visual_product_description: The pacifiers are available in both silicone and latex formulations in the following colors: powder blue, red, purple, and pink. Model numbers are located on the back of each package and are the last five digits of the UPC code: 35826 35827 35828 35829.

recall_description: These lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms, as required by federal law. Young children could ignite the lighters, posing fire and burn hazards.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: The recall involves two types of lighters. The first type is a refillable, liquid-fueled lighter with various decals depicting a frog with a banjo sitting on a lily, a man in the moon, Tweety Bird, a unicorn, and a skull and crossbones. The second type is a refillable, gas-fueled, piezo-electric lighter with a dolphin molded on the side, where the dolphin's head serves as a hinged cover for the ignition button and flame port.

recall_description: Gas valve mounting screws may not be fully tightened, leading to potential gas leaks, fire, and explosions.
remedies: Distributors and installers receive a Safety Notice package with instructions, replacement screws, and a reimbursement form. Installers should tighten the gas valve union and will be reimbursed.
visual_product_description: Condensing high-efficiency gas-fired boiler with 93% operating efficiency, cast aluminum heat exchanger, glossy silver/flat black jacket.

recall_description: The snap that secures the book could detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should cut off the snap from these books immediately and mail the snap to receive a free replacement book.
visual_product_description: Heavy cardboard books with cartoon characters on each page and a title printed with orange letters highlighted in yellow on the front cover. The books have a hole at the back to hang on a door knob and are printed in English and Spanish.

recall_description: Improper crimping of the brake cables could lead to reduced braking capacity, and in some cases, to failure of the foot pedal brake.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled vehicles and contact the nearest dealer to schedule an appointment to have a new brake cable installed free of charge.
visual_product_description: This recall involves utility vehicles that are 4- to 6-wheeled vehicles with cargo boxes.

recall_description: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control and fall.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using these bicycles and can receive a free replacement fork, including installation.
visual_product_description: The recalled forks were installed on certain orange Mongoose S-20 and MGX S-20 bicycles, and red Roadmaster Ridge Rider bicycles. The forks on these bikes are black with decals that read 'BALLISTIC' and '105' on the sides of the suspension fork legs. Serial numbers are located on the inside of the suspension fork legs.

recall_description: The lights' wires can be easily pulled out of the plugs and light sockets, posing electrocution, electric shock, and fire hazards.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these recalled light sets immediately and return them to the store where they were purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: 22-feet long with 140 non-replaceable miniature lights, multicolor bulbs with green wire, clear bulbs with white or green wire, push-button control box with eight lighting effects.

recall_description: The end piece of the drumstick handle can break off and the screw at the end of the drumstick can loosen and detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take these drumsticks away from young children and contact the manufacturer for a replacement set of drumsticks.
visual_product_description: Centipede-shaped drumsticks, about 10-inches long, sold in lime green or blue with black stripes.

recall_description: The fish's size, texture, shape and easy compressibility make it possible for an infant to compress the toy and place it in his or her mouth, potentially blocking the airway and causing choking.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take these squirting fish away from young children and throw them away. For additional information or to receive replacement squirt toys, consumers should contact the company.
visual_product_description: The Scoop Pour 'N Squirt bath toy set includes a large, colorful plastic fish-shaped scoop and two small plastic squirting fish. The Bath Time Pals bath toy set includes a squirting frog, two squirting pearls, and two squirting fish.

recall_description: The handles on the base of the slow cookers can break, posing a risk of burns from hot food spilling onto consumers.
remedies: Consumers will be shipped a replacement slow cooker base.
visual_product_description: The slow cookers have series codes A through D, and are available in solid white and various print designs, with capacities of 3.5 to 6.5 quarts.

recall_description: The chainstay that holds the rear wheel in place can fail, causing the rear wheel to separate from the bicycle. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the bicycles immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a free repair.
visual_product_description: The Slayer model is black metallic with red decals. The Edge model is royal blue with yellow decals. Both models have 'Made in Canada' printed on decals.

recall_description: Pedals can loosen and fall off, resulting in serious injury to the rider.
remedies: Free replacement pedal/crank set with free installation
visual_product_description: These are men's and women's mountain bicycles with the 26-inch, 18-speed features. The bicycles come in green-colored for women and red-colored for men.

recall_description: The sets contain razor knives, which pose a laceration hazard to children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take these razor knives away from children and return the pencil sets to the store where they purchased them for a refund.
visual_product_description: The school supply sets were sold in 8-inch plastic cases. The sets included a razor knife, pencils, scissors, a ruler, an eraser, a compass, and a tube of glue. The cases are blue, pink, yellow, or purple and have pictures of children or animals. Sold in plastic bags with cardboard headers marked '10 PCS SET PENCIL CASE & PENCIL HOLDER,' and 'MADE IN CHINA.'

recall_description: Vibration during operation can result in abrasion wear to the fuel tube, leading to a fuel leak, which can cause a fire and burn hazard
product_name: liquid-cooled overhead valve V-twin gasoline powered small engines
remedies: Consumers should stop using engine-equipped tractors immediately and contact the authorized dealer for a free repair. The repair will include installing a new fuel tube with a protective cover and a new clamp.
visual_product_description: 27 horsepower, liquid-cooled, overhead-valve (OHV), V-twin models with electric start and horizontal output shafts

recall_description: The boots may have been mislabeled to indicate that they are resistant to electrical current, which is incorrect. This may result in a serious shock or electrocution to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the boots immediately and return them to the company so they can be re-labeled or provided with a new pair of boots, free of charge.
visual_product_description: The recalled steel toe logger boots are brown and black and have laces that tie up to the calf. The recalled boots have stock numbers of G8320, G8322, and G9360, which can be found on a label under the tongue of the boot.

recall_description: Cribs have cut-outs in the end panels that allow young children to get their heads entrapped, risking strangulation. The cribs fail to meet safety standards.
product_name: wooden cribs with cut-outs in the end panels
remedies: Stop using the cribs immediately and contact the manufacturer to receive replacement end panels.

recall_description: In an extreme fire situation, it is possible for the electronic wires and mounting holes to become exposed posing a fire hazard risk. There is no danger of latch failure, nor will this prevent normal egress during an emergency evacuation.
remedies: Customers will be contacted directly to receive a replacement product. Products installed in certain fire-rated applications will be modified or replaced if requested by the customer.
visual_product_description: The product includes cylindrical and mortise electronic door lock products, often installed in commercial buildings such as college dormitories, schools, and hospitals.

recall_description: The AC adapters can overheat, posing a fire hazard. There have been five reports of fire contained to the cases of the AC adapters.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled AC adapter immediately and contact the manufacturer to order a free replacement AC adapter.

recall_description: Solder connections in the main power supply of the sewing machines can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should return the recalled sewing machines to the place where purchased to receive a free replacement power supply component.

recall_description: If the suction cups are not properly attached, they can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. There are no reports of injury.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these products immediately and contact the manufacturer to receive a new instruction sheet. The instruction sheet can also be downloaded from the manufacturer's website.
visual_product_description: The Snack and Activity Tray can attach to high chairs, strollers, swings and other flat surfaces. There are four toys on each tray, including a toucan with a rainbow colored beak, a clear ball with colored beads inside, a yellow star with a mirror on one side and a green dog. The toys are removable and interchangeable with other toys, which are purchased separately. The trays were sold from August 2001 through February 2002 for about $15.

recall_description: A small part inside the horn can pose a choking hazard when pulled off by a child.
remedies: Consumers should take the recalled cars away from young children immediately and contact the company to receive a replacement steering wheel.
visual_product_description: The push car is about 24-inches long, 14-inches wide, and 18-inches high with a natural wood body, red steering wheel column, red metal bar on the back, and red plastic horn on the steering wheel. Intended for children 1- to 3-years-old.

recall_description: The antennae on the lobster toy can break, posing a choking hazard to young children
product_name: Ocean Friends Stationary Entertainer lobster toys
remedies: Consumers should remove the lobster toy from the entertainer immediately and contact the company for a replacement toy.
visual_product_description: The recalled lobster toy is red with black antennae. It is part of a stationary entertainer with a green tray supported by three adjustable legs, featuring a seat with colorful sea animals.

recall_description: The back support buckle can detach from the shoulder straps, posing a fall hazard to the baby.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the carrier immediately and contact for instructions on returning the carriers for repair.
visual_product_description: The carriers are made of a cotton polyester blend fabric in black with red piping and blue with white piping.

recall_description: When exposed to severely cold temperatures and impact, the power cord insulation on the electric air pump can crack, creating a short-circuit or exposing live electrical wires and presenting a shock or electrocution hazard.

visual_product_description: All adjustable beds with electric air pumps sold from November 2002 through March 15, 2003, shipped through or to cold weather locations.

recall_description: The extension cords have undersized conductors and no over-current protection which causes overheating, presenting a shock and fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should unplug and stop using the extension cords immediately. Consumers should mail the cords for a refund, including the cost of postage.
visual_product_description: The recalled extension cords were sold in yellow and brown and are approximately 9-, 25-, 50-, 100-feet long. The 9-foot extension cord was packaged in a green sleeve card with the words 'Household Extension Cord' printed across the front. All remaining sizes were packaged in black sleeve cards with the words 'Air Conditioner Extension Cord' printed across the front.

recall_description: Bottles can leak at the cap, causing contents to come into contact with consumers, leading to burns to skin and eyes.
remedies: Stop using the cleaners immediately. Contact hotline to determine if the bottle is leaking and get refund.
visual_product_description: Gallon bottles with labels. 'REMOVES ALL FINISHES' and 'DANGER! CAUSES EYE, SKIN AND MUCOUS MEMBRANE BURNS' are written on the label.

recall_description: The lawn mowers have a rear-mounted grass bag that does not seal properly to the rear door of the mower, allowing grass and other debris to be thrown out. This could result in injury to the operator or bystanders.
product_name: electric walk-behind lawn mower grass bag attachments
remedies: Consumers should remove and dispose of the old grass bag and contact customer service to receive a free replacement bag.
visual_product_description: Grass bag attachments for 19-inch electric walk-behind lawn mowers with a rear-mounted grass bag.

recall_description: The door hinges can fail, causing the shower door to fall and injure nearby consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the shower doors immediately and contact the manufacturer to receive a replacement door.
visual_product_description: The recalled shower doors include various models made from January 1997 through September 2001. The doors were sold in chrome, brass, and white frame finishes, and various glass treatments, for shower enclosure and bathtub applications, in both single and double door configurations.

recall_description: Arcing may cause the fuser assembly to overheat, posing a fire hazard
remedies: Users should switch off the printer power when unattended, ensure that the 'power save' mode is enabled, and contact their distributor for a free retrofit.

recall_description: The recalled valves can have sharp internal edges that can cut into gasket seals in the valves, causing a propane gas leak, posing a risk of fire or burn injuries.
product_name: Safety relief valves for large propane tanks
remedies: Contact the importer to schedule an appointment to have the safety relief valve replaced at no charge.

Only valves with year and batch codes of '99.02,' '99.10', '99.16,' '99.27,' or '99.28' are included in the recall. They were installed on tanks that were refurbished or manufactured after May 1999 and sold for between $10 and $15.

recall_description: The fleece fabric on the inside of these sweatshirts fails to meet federal mandatory standards of fabric flammability because it can ignite readily if exposed to flame, presenting a serious risk of burn injuries.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop wearing these sweatshirts and return them to the store where purchased for a full refund.
visual_product_description: Heather-gray, hooded sweatshirts with a full-zippered front, embroidered with "P87" on the left chest, available in sizes small through XXL, made of 65% cotton and 35% polyester.

recall_description: A faulty electrical connection can cause the heater to overheat and stop working, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled heaters immediately and contact the company to arrange for shipping and a repair, free of charge.
visual_product_description: The recalled portable electric whole room heaters are designed for indoor use and have model numbers 180VH, VH, Intellitemp, EVH, and DVH. Each heater is about 11 ¾ inches long, 9 ½ inches wide, and about 12 inches tall; weighs about 6 lbs.

recall_description: Potential risk of electrocution or electric shock due to faulty on/off switches in the rope and cable light kits.
product_name: on/off switches for rope and cable lights
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled on/off switches and contact the manufacturer for a replacement switch free of charge.
visual_product_description: Rectangular white plastic box about 1¼ inches long containing a wheel-type switch through the middle that rotates to turn the power on and off.

recall_description: The toy car on the bar can break during use, resulting in a small plastic part that poses a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should remove the toy car from the toy bar immediately and request a free replacement toy.

recall_description: The cords have reversed polarity, presenting electric shock and electrocution hazards.
remedies: Consumers should unplug the cords immediately and return them using a prepaid shipping label to receive a free replacement or a full refund.
visual_product_description: Black extension cords about one to two feet long, with the letters 'MSL' imprinted on the three-pronged plug, and website or name printed on the cord or splitter.

recall_description: A short circuit can occur in the battery compartment, creating a possible thermal burn hazard if the battery compartment lid is touched.
remedies: Consumers should immediately remove the batteries and contact the company to receive a free replacement digital camera.
visual_product_description: The camera is mostly silver-colored with lavender around the lens.

recall_description: Components inside the soda machine can break apart, posing a serious risk of lacerations to consumers who can be struck by shrapnel.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these soda machines immediately and call the company to receive a free repair. Unused machines should be discarded to prevent the possibility of injury.

The model name, "Drink Master," "Drink Maker," "The Drink Machine," or "The Carbonator" is printed in black on the front of the machine. Under the lid are the words "Made in Sweden."

recall_description: The plastic handles attached to the fondue pots can melt and crack during heating, posing burn and fire hazards. Reports of plastic handles breaking or melting, with 6 reports of burn injuries.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the fondue set and contact the company to receive a replacement fondue pot with safer handles and an incentive gift set of six stoneware fork rests.

The pot has black triangular handles with a center hole on either side and sits on a black, four-legged stand housing the burner.

recall_description: The green coating on the Lily Pad Clacker instruments contains high levels of lead, posing a risk of poisoning to young children.
remedies: Return the instrument to the company. The company will replace it with a product of comparable value.
visual_product_description: The instrument is 5.25 inches long, made of wood, featuring two green lily pads connected to a base by a string.

recall_description: Brake pad separation and brake disc rivet shear leading to potential brake failure; no reported incidents or injuries.
remedies: Contact dealer for free replacement of brake pads and/or disc.
visual_product_description: Snowmobiles with red hoods and nose pans and white and blue graphics. Model number found on the right side of the tunnel.

recall_description: The cords have undersized wires, presenting a shock hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using and unplug these extension cords immediately and return them to the manufacturer for a refund, including postage.
visual_product_description: The recalled extension cords were sold in brown or white and are approximately 5-feet 3-inches long. The model numbers are printed in the upper right corner of the packaging, with packaging in a mustard and orange color sleeve.

recall_description: hot air is vented below the small oven causing the metal surface on the door to get too hot, posing a burn hazard.
remedies: consumers should stop using the small ovens immediately and contact their local authorized service center to arrange a free repair.
visual_product_description: stainless steel, 48-inch ranges with small and large side-by-side ovens

recall_description: The spindle on the saw may slip, causing the blade to contact the lower guard, posing a hazard from an exposed blade.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the circular saws immediately and return them to the nearest service center for a free repair.

recall_description: The red plastic skis could crack or break due to UV exposure, leading to loss of control and potential injury or death.
remedies: Free repair at authorized dealers.
visual_product_description: All 2004 snowmobiles with red plastic skis, model name on either side of the hood.

recall_description: Fuel can leak from the fuel-line connection, posing a fire hazard
remedies: Consumers should stop using these snowblowers immediately and return the unit to a local dealer for a free repair.
visual_product_description: The snowblowers are orange or green with model numbers and serial numbers located on the lower handlebar.

recall_description: The stems on these bicycles can loosen during use, causing riders to lose control and fall.

visual_product_description: 20-inch BMX bicycles, metallic green and dark blue chrome colors, model numbers 8535-99 and 8527-99, manufactured between March 2002 and June 2002.

recall_description: The balloon tongue on this toy can detach, posing a choking and aspiration hazard to young children. A 3-year-old boy reportedly removed the balloon tongue, placed it in his nose and inhaled it into his sinus cavity. He required medical treatment to remove the part from his nose.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take these toys from young children and return the toy to the restaurant where it was purchased for a free replacement toy. Consumers can also receive a free replacement toy directly from the company.
visual_product_description: The Bug Zapper toy comes in two different styles: a frog and a lizard. When the toy is squeezed, the balloon tongue of the toy rolls out from the mouth about 2 inches. They toys were mainly orange, green and purple. 'CHINA' is molded into the toy.

recall_description: The lower blade guards on these circular saws can stick in the open position, exposing the blade and posing a serious laceration hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these circular saws immediately and return them to the manufacturer for a free repair.

recall_description: The pads on the sanders can break apart during use and strike the operator, posing an injury hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled sanders immediately and return them to the nearest factory service center for a free repair.

recall_description: Battery packs can detach from the power tool unexpectedly and strike the operator or bystander, resulting in injuries.

recall_description: The antennae on the butterfly toys contain wire that can pass through the fabric, causing cuts and scratches to babies.

recall_description: The systems can fail to communicate with the central station that should receive the distress signal, potentially failing to alert emergency services.
remedies: Consumers should contact their service dealers immediately to arrange for an inspection and repair. In the meantime, should not rely on their security systems for emergency contact.

recall_description: The folding mechanism creates a pinch-point where the steering column meets the base, causing potential injuries during folding or unfolding.

recall_description: The on-off trigger can stick, or the lock-on button can jam, posing a risk of physical injury.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the hammer drills immediately and return them to the place where purchased to receive a full refund.
visual_product_description: The drills have blue plastic housings, black triggers with yellow lock-on buttons, and yellow/orange gear-shift dials on the side. The drills are equipped with an accessory front-end handle that includes a depth gauge, and were sold in a gray plastic case.

recall_description: The wheels on the toy car can come off, posing a choking hazard to young children
remedies: Consumers should take the toy away from small children immediately and return the toy to the manufacturer for a full refund, including postage.
visual_product_description: The Sonato Smiling Mini-Car Toy is wood with four solid-colored wheels painted orange, blue, yellow, and green. A smiling face is painted on the front. On the top of the toy is a red button that squeaks when pushed.

recall_description: Metal and plastic casters can break causing objects on the cart to fall
remedies: Consumers receive new casters free of charge
visual_product_description: The media cart has an ash wood veneer with a dark brown stain, measures 31.75" x 19" x 23.5", and contains a VCR shelf and a second compartment shelf for CDs.

recall_description: The cutting blade can separate from the center-coring ring during use causing cuts to consumers' hands and fingers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these apple slicers/corers immediately and return them to either the place of purchase or the company to receive a replacement or a refund.
visual_product_description: The slicers/corers are made of shiny chrome metal with two handles.

recall_description: The starting fluid cans can leak as a result of internal to external corrosion, posing a fire hazard due to its extreme flammability. Direct contact with the product can also irritate the consumer's eyes and skin.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled starting fluid immediately, place it in a well-ventilated area away from sparks or flames, and call the company for information on disposal and refund.

recall_description: A sharp edge on the metal heat shield below the control panel of the grill can cause lacerations.
remedies: A repair kit with a plastic sheath to cover the sharp edge on the heat shield.
visual_product_description: The grills are green and black, have a red emblem on the grill's cover, a wheeled cart with two side tables or one side table and a side burner, and a warming rack above the grilling surface.

recall_description: a plastic replica of a balloon attached to the book can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children
product_name: children's board book with a small plastic replica of a balloon
remedies: consumers should take the books away from young children and contact the company to receive a replacement book
visual_product_description: heavy-cardboard book with 'Whose Birthday Is It?' printed on the cover in yellow letters featuring Dora the Explorer cartoon characters on each page, with a cutout in the top left corner having a small plastic replica of a balloon attached

recall_description: The bottom of the hot pot can separate from the top, causing a burn hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the hot pots immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a full refund.
visual_product_description: The hot pots are made of white plastic, shaped like a pitcher, and are used to heat beverages.

recall_description: The dried apples and cinnamon in the candle can ignite causing a flare up and breaking the glass, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the candle and return it for a refund.
visual_product_description: The scented candle is housed in a clear glass holder and has a crumbled appearance with color variations. It contains slices of dried apple and cinnamon sticks in the wax. The candle is 3 inches in diameter and 3.5 inches high.

recall_description: The caps on some of the Fiddlesticks can become loose, allowing ball bearings to spill from the inside of the sticks, posing a potential choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the Fiddlesticks immediately and return them to their educator for a free replacement with either re-designed Fiddlesticks or an instrument of comparable value.
visual_product_description: The recalled instrument is 7 inches long, 1 inch in diameter, and is made of wood. It is hollowed out in the middle, with steel balls inserted to create a shaker sound. The ends are capped with wooden plugs.

recall_description: A partially crimped sleeve on these flagpoles can allow the cable to pull through the sleeve causing the loop to release. When the assembly is raised with no flag attached, it can allow a seven pound counter weight to drop to the ground, possibly hitting people nearby.
remedies: Providing free repair kits to fix the issue.
visual_product_description: These Internal Halyard flagpoles have a hinged door and a metal cable on the outside of the pole.

recall_description: The adhesive contains toluene, presenting a fire and poisoning hazard. Packaging lacks required cautionary labeling under the Federal Hazardous Substances Act.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the adhesive immediately and contact the company for a full refund.
visual_product_description: The adhesive comes in a soft metal squeeze tube about 1" x 5" with a screw top, marked 'Super Contact Adhesive,' in colors yellow, orange, blue, and white. The UPC code is 7-31015-04471-9.

recall_description: Mislocated welds securing the upper front suspension arm mounting brackets to the frame, potentially causing loss of control and resulting in crash and severe personal injury or death.
remedies: Free inspection and repair at authorized dealership.
visual_product_description: The 2004 model year four-wheel drive ATVs, model numbers LT-A400FK4 (automatic transmission) and LT-F400FK4 (manual transmission). Available in red, yellow, or green.

recall_description: The glider rockers were manufactured improperly with soft wood and with nails rather than with wood screws in the gliding joints. They can break apart causing occupants to fall to the floor.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the chairs and contact for a repair kit to stabilize the rocker.
visual_product_description: These are Bentwood Glider Rockers with a nostalgic oak finish, designed to move back and forth using metal bearings. They come with or without an accompanying ottoman.

recall_description: The cabinets can detach from the wall and fall, possibly injuring consumers.
remedies: Consumers should carefully remove the cabinet's contents and contact Mill's Pride to receive a free repair kit.
visual_product_description: The cabinets are white, measure 54 inches wide by 24 inches high, have three doors, two adjustable shelves, and one divider panel, and are made of particle board with a white vinyl laminate.

recall_description: The handlebar could unexpectedly loosen causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle.
remedies: Stop using the bicycles and contact the company to determine if the product is a part of the recall. Consumers will receive a free replacement handlebar and stem.
visual_product_description: Single-speed bicycles with 26-inch wheels and both men's and ladies' style frames. The bicycles have serial numbers ranging from SNHHE04C52556 to SNHHE04C64557.

recall_description: The wax from the candles can drip and ignite the potpourri. Additionally, when candles are close, they generate significant heat, leading to fire hazards and potential burn injuries.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the candle sets immediately and return them to any store for a full refund.
visual_product_description: The set contains seven candles (three white pillars, two red apple-shaped novelty candles, and two yellow leaf-shaped novelty candles), potpourri, and a round 12-inch copper color plate.

recall_description: The rugs violate the federal Flammable Fabrics Act and could ignite, presenting a risk of burn injuries.
remedies: Consumers should contact the distributor to arrange for the product to be picked up and shipped back for a full refund when returned.
visual_product_description: Periwinkle blue chenille rugs, available in sizes 8' x 10' and 5' x 8', made of 65% rayon and 35% cotton.

recall_description: The nipple on the toy baby bottle could come off, posing a serious choking hazard to small children.
remedies: Consumers should take these recalled toys away from young children immediately, and return the toy set to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: The plastic toy feeding set includes a baby bottle, plastic dish, strainer, spoon, juicer, and, in some sets, a funnel. The sets are available in various colors including blue, yellow, pink, and purple.

recall_description: The drawcord around the ankle of these slippers can break and release the toggle used to tighten the drawcord. The toggle presents a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should take these slippers away from young children immediately, and return them for an exchange or refund.
visual_product_description: The slippers are made of red, blue or aqua fleece fabric, and have a suede sole. The drawcord around the ankle has a barrel toggle to tighten the slipper to adjust the fit. A fabric label is sewn below the drawcord on the rear of the slipper. 'MADE IN CHINA' is written on the sole of the slippers. They were sold in sizes XXS (3.5 to 5.5) and XS (6 to 8).

recall_description: Extra internal vent line attached to the plastic vent fitting on some fuel tanks causing potential fuel leaks, presenting fire and burn hazards.
remedies: Stop using the vehicle, move it outside to a ventilated area, and loosen the fuel cap to equalize pressure. Contact dealer for free inspection and repair.
visual_product_description: Off-road utility vehicles with four or six wheels, model number on side of a cargo box attached to the back.

recall_description: The black plastic handles of the pocket knives can crack, posing a risk of injury from the blade.
remedies: Consumers should contact the manufacturer to receive a free replacement knife.
visual_product_description: Model 425BK MiniBuck Black Knives have a plastic handle and a non-serrated 1-7/8 inch drop-point blade. The knives are 2-7/8 inches long when closed and 4-3/4 inches when open. Each of the subject knives bears the designation "T" on the blade of the knife after the model number.

recall_description: The lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms, presenting fire and burn hazards.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately to receive a full refund.
visual_product_description: Dark green, metal lighters in the shape of the Statue of Liberty with flame coming out of the top of the torch and tablets in her left hand acting as the ignition switch.

recall_description: Stress cracks in the mower's fuel tank can cause gasoline to leak, posing a risk of fire and burn injuries.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled mowers and contact the company for a free replacement fuel tank.
visual_product_description: Recalled models are walk-behind, 21-inch mowers powered by 2-cycle engines, with model and serial numbers located on the mower's housing.

recall_description: The circuit testers can fail to indicate if electric current is present, posing a risk of electric shock to consumers.
remedies: Consumers with these testers should stop using them immediately and contact the importer for a refund.
visual_product_description: These are about 5.25 inches long and look similar to a small screwdriver, featuring a clear plastic handle with a spring and small light inside, and a red plastic end cap. No writing is on the testers.

recall_description: Batteries can leak or explode when used with an AC adapter. Consumers can suffer burns from the leaking battery or can be struck by pieces of an exploding battery.
remedies: Consumers should immediately remove the batteries and contact the manufacturer for a replacement unit or refund. A merchandise certificate will be given for the next purchase if the unit is returned or shipped back.
visual_product_description: The CD rack is black with a round dial and stands about 3-feet high on a 14-inch base. The rack holds 100 CDs and rotates automatically, clockwise or counter-clockwise, when you turn the dial. Only units with codes REV A or REV B under the base are included in this recall.

recall_description: Some of the cabinets have the wrong sized screws for the safety bracket, resulting in improper securing to the wall and potential falling hazard.
remedies: Offering a free repair kit with replacement screws and repair instructions for consumers to secure the cabinet properly.
visual_product_description: Glass-door wall cabinets about 67-inches high.

recall_description: The plastic oil canister can melt when the torch is in use posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled torch immediately and return it to the store for a refund.
visual_product_description: The bamboo torch is made of bamboo and stands about five feet tall. The oil canister is housed at the top and the bottom has a spiked tip to stick into the ground. The oil canister is removable and has a black metal top with a hole for the wick to stick out. Instructions and warnings for the use of the product are written on the outside of the oil canister.

recall_description: The crocheted cherry-shape tassels and plastic buttons may pull off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should return the rompers to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: pink and white gingham with pink buttons and crocheted cherry-shape tassels on the pocket and green and white gingham bows on the trim of the leg openings. Sold in infant sizes 12-months to 24-months and toddler sizes 2T to 5T.

recall_description: Leak current from the heating element posing a risk of electric shock
remedies: Repair is necessary to assure continued safe operation. Free repair includes the cost of shipping.

recall_description: When the ratchet winch, or hook, is under tension, it can detach and be projected, posing a risk of serious injury or death to user or bystander.
remedies: Return the ratchet winch kit to the dealer for a refund.
visual_product_description: The ratchet winch kit is made of black metal and has a metal wheel with about a 5-inch diameter attached to a metal arm that measures about 9-inches in length.

recall_description: The candleholders can tip over, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the candleholders immediately and return them for a full refund.
visual_product_description: The candleholders are shaped like a tree, made of metal, gold in color, about 24 inches tall and 15 inches wide with six metal hooks and glass cups for votive candles.

recall_description: A component of the electronic control panel can malfunction, causing the motor and walking belt to rapidly accelerate and the user can lose balance and fall.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these treadmills immediately and contact Horizon Fitness to receive a repair kit and to set up an appointment for an in-home repair.

recall_description: The seat post's cradle, which attaches to the bicycle seat, can break, posing the risk of falls and serious injury to riders.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these seat posts immediately and return them to the company for a free repair.

recall_description: An internal part in the lever mechanism can break, reducing clamping effectiveness and rendering the unit inoperable, potentially causing a bicyclist to fall.
remedies: Free replacement of the quick releases.

recall_description: The Giant Champagne Glass-Shaped Floating Candleholder can unexpectedly shatter and cause cuts to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the candleholders immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund or a merchandise credit.
visual_product_description: The candleholder is a large, 17 1/4-inch high by 13-inch in diameter glass item, shaped like a champagne glass, made of mouth-blown recycled glass, intended for use with floating candles.

recall_description: These helmets fail impact testing required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets, violating the Consumer Product Safety Act. Riders wearing these helmets are not adequately protected from falls, and could suffer head injuries.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these helmets immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund or free replacement helmet.
visual_product_description: The helmets are black, white or red with the model name '540' printed inside.

recall_description: The head can detach from the body of the villagers, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the toy sets immediately and return them for a full refund, including postage costs.
visual_product_description: The Happyvillagers are made with birchwood and painted with various villager images, sold in sets of 12 villagers.

recall_description: The mini-bicycles do not have any brakes or chain guards, which are required by the CPSC standard. This absence may lead to injuries such as lacerations from exposed gears.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these mini-bicycles immediately and get a free repair kit.
visual_product_description: The mini-bicycles are 24-inches long and 26-inches high with 6-inch wheels. They have adjustable seat and handlebars with quick release levers. Available in red, blue, black or chrome colors with black seats and handle grips.

recall_description: If the thermostat fails, the plastic housing of the percolator can overheat and melt while in use, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these percolators immediately and contact the company for refund information.
visual_product_description: The white plastic percolators have gray bases. One version is decorated with three red flowers on the front and another is plain white with text on the front.

recall_description: The plug can break open and expose live wires, posing an electrocution or electric shock hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the AC plugs immediately and contact the company to obtain a free replacement plug.

recall_description: The Party Popper is a rocket-shaped device that shoots into the air when the string is pulled. The cone-shaped top can pop off rapidly, and can hit and injure both children and adults.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these Party Poppers immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: The recalled Party Poppers are packaged in units of four. The Party Poppers were sold in clear cellophane wrappers with blue, yellow and red cardboard headers. The Party Poppers are shaped like rockets with 3 1/2-inch wooden support sticks.

recall_description: The paint on the metal wires of these toys contains excess levels of lead, which is a serious hazard to children.
product_name: flower shaped toy intended to attach to a stroller with a metal wire on which plastic beads slide along
remedies: Consumers should immediately take these toys away from infants and young children and contact the company for return and replacement instructions.
visual_product_description: A flower shaped toy with a green painted metal wire for sliding plastic beads, designed to attach to a stroller.

recall_description: The pooling of wax can ignite the paint on the duck, posing fire and burn hazards.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the candles immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: The candles are 3 1/2 inches tall, in the shape of a yellow duck sitting on a green base with a blue ribbon around its neck and an orange beak.

recall_description: The toys' seams can separate and allow small beads to be released, presenting an aspiration hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should contact the company for a free replacement toy.
visual_product_description: Four animal plush toys: a white rabbit with a purple egg reading 'Happy Easter,' a green rabbit with a yellow egg reading 'Happy Easter,' a purple bear with a purple egg reading 'Happy Easter,' and a yellow duck with a green egg reading 'You're Egg-stra Special.'

recall_description: The vent flue insulation can be out of position on these ranges, causing scorching or burning of the cabinetry around the range, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the broil and self-clean functions immediately. Notices will be mailed to consumers whose ranges need to be inspected, and they will be repaired free of charge if needed.

recall_description: The seatbelts can unintentionally unlatch, posing a risk of serious injury to riders.
remedies: Stop riding the go-kart and repair the seat belts free of charge.
visual_product_description: Blue go-karts with neon-green pads on the brush bars and includes model numbers GT60102x92A or GT60304A with manufacturing date codes from 00082 to 00147.

recall_description: Using power cords not intended for these adapters can pose a shock hazard.
remedies: Free retrofit kits to prevent incorrect cables from being connected to the adapters.
visual_product_description: Adapter with P/N W1451 printed on top, compatible with various notebook models.

recall_description: The plastic ring with handles that is attached to the upper rim of the fondue pot can crack during normal heating or cooling, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the fondue set immediately to receive a replacement fondue pot.
visual_product_description: Metal fondue pot available in blue or white with a black plastic ring attached to the upper rim including two handles for safe usage, sitting on a black four-legged stand housing the burner.

recall_description: The circuit board in the lamps can overheat and melt the plastic housing, posing a fire or thermal burn hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these lights immediately, unplug them, and return them to the place of redemption for an alternative item of the same value.
visual_product_description: The blue, red, green, or multi-colored lights are about 17 inches in height and have a curved, colored piece of glass (the bulb) that inserts into a black base. When the snake light is turned on it gives off the appearance of "lightning" running through the lamp and into the bulb.

recall_description: The zipper box may detach, allowing the zipper slide to detach, posing a risk of choking on small parts.
remedies: Consumers stop using the product and contact the company for a replacement or refund.

recall_description: These water slides have an excessive length of rope attached to the safety mat that presents a risk of entanglement in the water. This poses a drowning hazard to users.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the slides and contact the distributor to request a free repair kit. After making the repair, consumers can resume using the product.
visual_product_description: A large inflatable slide, 5-feet high and 9-feet long, used for sliding into a pool or lake. It is green with orange handles.

recall_description: The ramps can crack causing users to fall and suffer injuries. Gen-X Sports has received one report of the ramp cracking, where the user fell and broke his collarbone.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these ramps immediately and contact the company to receive a refund.
visual_product_description: The ramps are black and have four peg holes used to anchor the ramp, located on the underside in each corner. They measure 39-inches long, 28-inches wide, and up to 12-inches high.

recall_description: The length of the crank arm in the 2003 model fails to allow sufficient space between the rider's foot and the front wheel, causing potential for loss of control and injury.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled bicycles immediately and contact the company to have the crankset replaced free of charge.

recall_description: The plastic protective shell of these guards can break when hit against a hard surface, resulting in impact injuries to the head. Received reports include the plastic shells breaking, causing cuts and abrasions to the head and ear.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these ear guards immediately and return them to the store where purchased or to the firm for a free replacement.
visual_product_description: The guard includes two plastic ear pieces covered with neoprene nylon. The guards are white, red, purple, black, navy blue, royal blue, green or gold.

recall_description: The lighters may have child-resistant mechanisms that do not meet federal safety standards, posing a potential fire hazard if operated by young children.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately to receive a full refund.
visual_product_description: The recalled lighters are made of metal, come in different colors, have a top that resembles a pencil across a protractor and triangle, and include a ruler along the side. They are about three inches high, 7/8 inches wide and 1/4 inch deep, and have a label with the UPC code 7 63052 20108 5, "MADE IN CHINA" and "SLIDE PUSH."

recall_description: One of the puzzle pieces (a stack of newspapers) poses a small parts choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the puzzles and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: The recalled product is a wooden puzzle with nine pieces forming a green recycling truck, three workers, a container for plastics, a bundled set of newspapers, and a recycling bin. The top of the puzzle reads, 'Recycling Truck', and it has '2574' and '2003 Small World Toys' printed at the bottom.

recall_description: The glass on these lamps can shatter when lit, posing a fire and laceration hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these lamps immediately and return them to the store for a refund.
visual_product_description: The recalled lamps come in two shapes: 16 by 7 inch-rectangular, and 7.5 inch-square. The top piece of the clear rectangular lamp has an opening for five wicks, and the top piece of the clear square lamp has an opening for one wick. The lamps have two stacking glass pieces supported by a black metal frame. The lower glass piece has a reservoir for oil.

recall_description: The flame of a candle placed inside the Jack-O-Lantern could ignite the straw ribbon on the outside, posing fire and burn hazards.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the Jack-O-Lanterns and return them to the store for a full refund.
visual_product_description: The recalled ceramic Jack-O-Lanterns are shaped like a pumpkin, tan colored with an opening in the back and a straw ribbon attached to the stem.

recall_description: The soap may get too hot when heated in the microwave oven and leak from the plastic container posing a burn hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using these kits immediately and contact for information on how to receive a full refund and an additional product item at no charge.
visual_product_description: Includes bars of soap, molds, and a plastic cup to melt soap chunks.

recall_description: component failure can cause the machine to catch on fire
remedies: Consumers should stop using the machines immediately and contact the company to get a free replacement.

recall_description: The forks on the bicycles can develop cracks near the crown area resulting in failure of the fork and posing a risk of injury to the rider.
remedies: Return the bicycles with the recalled forks to the dealer to receive a free replacement
visual_product_description: The recall involves 'Wolf' all-carbon road bike forks with a 1-inch diameter threadless steer tube. The bicycle forks were sold with 2003 model Soloist Team and Super Prodigy bicycles and framesets. A 17cm logo is printed in white outlined letters on both fork legs.

recall_description: Flames from the tea-light candle can ignite the candleholder, posing a fire hazard and risk of burn injuries.
remedies: Stop using the candleholders immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: The recalled Halloween ghost candleholders are about 10 inches tall and made of acrylic. The ghosts are white and hold a small orange pumpkin in which the tea-light candle sits. Two orange pumpkins are painted along the hem of the ghost. The candleholders were made in China.

recall_description: If the glass sleeves are not properly secured around the wicks, or the wicks are not properly inserted, the top glass of the lamps could shatter.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the glass oil lamps immediately and contact the company for information on how to return the lamps to receive a refund.
visual_product_description: Oil lamp with three or five wicks; the base includes black rods in a rectangular shape supporting a bottom glass reservoir for oil; the top glass rests on the reservoir and contains three or five holes for wicks.

recall_description: The bug's antenna can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should return the toy for a replacement toy.
visual_product_description: A toy bug about 3 inches long and 2 1/2 inch wide with a yellow face, red antennas, orange feet, and a purple body with green spots. The toy's legs move back and forth when rolled.

recall_description: The tea kettles can break or burst during use, spilling hot water, which poses the risk of burn injuries to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the tea kettles immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund or free replacement.
visual_product_description: Ceramic tea kettle glazed black with either a brown wooden handle, or a ceramic handle similar in color to the kettle. Stamped with 'Made in Brazil'.

recall_description: The red mallet sold with the toy xylophone can get lodged in the throats of young children, posing a choking hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take this toy away from children and return it to their local store for a full refund.
visual_product_description: The toy xylophone is white, rectangular-shaped with a green handle and multi-colored bars including red, yellow, green, and blue. A yellow button shaped like the face of a cat is on the front of the xylophone. The mallet sold with the xylophone is red with two round balls at either end of the mallet. Writing on the box reads, 'BABY TOYS XYLOPHONE, TO HELP BABY LEARN AND DEVELOP, and MADE IN CHINA.'

recall_description: These lighters can burn with a high flame and can fail to extinguish, presenting fire and burn hazards. There is one report of second degree burns to a consumer.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the lighters and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: Oval-tube-shaped lighters with 'TURBO 2000' printed on the body. They have a green, red, blue, black or yellow body, a metal top, with labels indicating 'CHILD-RESISTANT DISPOSABLE LIGHTER' and 'MADE IN CHINA'.

recall_description: The head and boot of the dolls can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should take the wooden dolls away from young children immediately and contact the company for information on how to receive a free replacement doll set.
visual_product_description: The recall involves Toddler Doll Family sets sold with four figurines: a mom, dad, brother, and sister. The 4-inch-tall dolls have a wooden head, arms, and feet. The body is constructed of wire, which makes the doll adjustable. Each doll has yarn hair and is dressed in various colored outfits.

recall_description: The plastic windows on the "see-inside" sorting blocks can break, causing the beads inside to be released, presenting a choking hazard to children.
product_name: shape sorter toy with hardwood box and colored blocks filled with beads
remedies: Consumers should take the recalled shape sorters away from children immediately and return the toys to the store where purchased for a refund.
visual_product_description: The recalled "Sort & See" sorting box is made of hardwood and comes with eight shaped blocks of various colors. Each block is filled with beads visible through plastic windows. The wooden box has a clear plastic top and cutouts on two sides that correspond with the shapes of the blocks.

recall_description: The longest knife in the set when inserted 'blade side-up' can protrude through the bottom of the knife block, presenting a risk of laceration injuries to consumers when the block is carried.
remedies: Consumers will receive a brass plate to install on the bottom of the knife block to prevent the knives from protruding.

recall_description: The paint on the metal mesh can ignite when exposed to a direct flame, posing a serious fire hazard to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the fireplace screens immediately and return them to any store for a refund.
visual_product_description: The 500RR model screens have a light rust color and use standard Phillips-head hinge pins.

recall_description: The electrical connections inside of the heater can become loose, causing the heater's metal frame to become energized, posing a serious electric shock hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using these heaters, disable and discard them. The firm is out of business and a remedy is no longer available.
visual_product_description: The recalled electric heaters have model numbers 797 or 797 DFT, painted white or gray, with a control panel for temperature and wattage selections. The units are rounded and metal.

recall_description: The stem can break away from the bicycle, causing a loss of control, falls and serious injury to riders.
remedies: Consumers should stop riding the bicycles with these stems immediately and contact a local retailer for a free repair.

recall_description: Frames of these bicycles can break apart, causing the rider to fall and suffer injuries.
product_name: Men's bicycles with 26-inch wheels, 21-speed, dual-suspension, and a double-bar white frame.
remedies: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund or store credit.
visual_product_description: 26-inch, 21-speed, dual-suspension men's bicycle with a double-bar white frame. Includes decals reading '2100DH' or 'PRO-X'.

recall_description: The forks on the bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control, fall and suffer serious injury.
