remedies: Consumers should stop using the product and contact the company to verify if it is part of the recall. If verified, consumers will receive replacement products or a full refund by returning the carrier’s straps and tag with contact information.
visual_product_description: The carriers are black with an ergonomic design meant to be worn on the front. They feature broad shoulder straps, safety buckles, and a supportive base for the baby. Gray accents are present along the seams and buckles for additional style and support.

recall_description: Hot exhaust gases can escape from the muffler, potentially melting the fuel tank or igniting grease, oil, or debris, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the blowers immediately and schedule a free inspection and repair.
visual_product_description: Gas-powered backpack blowers with a red and black engine housing and a white fuel tank. They have a sturdy handle, a large black air intake cover, and a protective frame surrounding the engine. The muffler is located on the side, and there are various control switches on the handle for operation.

recall_description: Wooden slats supporting the bunk beds can break while in use, posing fall and impact hazards.
product_name: Wooden twin over twin bunk beds
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bunk beds and contact the company to receive a free repair kit consisting of 12 wooden slats and new instructions.
visual_product_description: A wooden twin over twin bunk bed with a solid build. It features a simple, rectangular design with horizontal slats on the headboards and footboards. The upper bunk has guard rails on all sides, and there is a ladder affixed to one side for accessing the top bunk. The bunk beds are supported by four sturdy legs, and the wooden slats are spaced evenly across the lower frame to support the mattresses. The finish is black, emphasizing a sleek and traditional look.

recall_description: Full-size toys sing and swim, mini-size swim only. Hard plastic top fin poses impalement, laceration, and puncture risks, especially in bathtubs or wading pools.
product_name: Full-size and mini-size swimming bath toys
remedies: Consumers should stop using bath toys immediately; disable the tail fin (cut or bend), mark with 'recalled' and given code, upload a photo to designated website for a refund.
visual_product_description: Yellow toy shark with a large eye, prominent dorsal and tail fins, and cartoonish design. It appears vibrant and playful, with water-activated features indicated on the packaging.

recall_description: The coatings on the snaps in the overalls and shirt contain excessive amounts of lead, posing a serious risk of lead poisoning and adverse health effects to young children.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the products immediately and contact for a full refund.
visual_product_description: The product includes two sets of children's overalls with coordinating shirts. One set features red plaid denim overalls with a white shirt trimmed in red, and the other includes navy blue corduroy overalls with a white shirt trimmed in green. Both sets are adorned with decorative train appliqués across the chest of the overalls. The garments appear to have snaps used for fastening.

recall_description: Incorrect wiring causes the microwave's exterior to reach temperatures exceeding 183 degrees Fahrenheit, posing a burn hazard to the user.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled microwave ovens and contact for a free in-home repair.
visual_product_description: The product is a countertop convection microwave oven, with a stainless steel exterior and a digital display. It features a transparent black door window and a control panel on the right side with a keypad and digital clock display.

recall_description: The centerpiece of these bicycle aero bars can crack or break, causing the bicycle rider to lose control and crash.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the bicycle aero bars immediately and contact the company to have their aero bars tested. A free replacement will be provided for any bicycle aero bars found defective.
visual_product_description: Handlebar extensions with a cast aluminum centerpiece attached to a handlebar, a stem, and two aero bars, approximately 15 inches long, protruding in front of the handlebar. The bars have cushioned arm rests and are primarily black with gold lettering along the sides.

recall_description: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The tattoo numbing cream contains lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children if they ingest it.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled cream and store it out of reach of children. Follow instructions on how to dispose of the product to receive a full refund. Sellers are contacting all known purchasers directly.
visual_product_description: The product is contained in a white tube with a flip-top closure. The tube is predominantly green and white in color, with text indicating it as a topical pain treatment for tattoos. The phrase '6 hours' is printed in yellow, emphasizing the duration of the effect. The back of the tube includes a drug facts label, highlighting the main ingredients, including Lidocaine 5% and Vitamin E. The tube is designed for maximum strength pain relief.

recall_description: The candle holder can ignite, posing fire and burn hazards.
remedies: Consumer should immediately stop using the recalled candle holders and return them to any store for a full refund.
visual_product_description: A black candle holder styled as a haunted townhouse, approximately 20 inches tall and 7 inches wide. It features multiple arched windows with mesh detailing and is designed with two columns of candle placements, one above the other. The structure is detailed with sloped roofs and decorative elements resembling a spooky, gothic house.

recall_description: The metal pendant on the necklace contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues.
product_name: Girl's clothing sets with pendant necklace
remedies: Consumers should stop using the necklace, take it away from children, and return it to the place of purchase for a full refund.
visual_product_description: The product consists of a teal top with cut-out shoulders featuring lace details and ruffle at the hem, a navy blue legging with a teal floral pattern, and a pendant necklace with a gold leaf design and teal and orange center.

recall_description: Heat from the exhaust can melt the plastic panels behind the operator and passenger seat, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled vehicles and schedule a free repair.
visual_product_description: This is a recreational off-highway vehicle with a robust design, featuring four large all-terrain wheels. The vehicle has a roll cage and side-by-side seating for two occupants with a steering wheel for the operator. The exterior includes vibrant designs on the sides, a prominent grille at the front, and side panels made of durable material. The vehicle appears suitable for rugged outdoor use, with a suspension system visible and tires designed for rough terrain.

recall_description: The glass beer mug can break if heated or used with hot liquid, posing burn and laceration hazards.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop heating or using the recalled glass beer mugs with hot liquid and return them to the nearest store for a full refund.
visual_product_description: A clear glass mug with a rounded body and a sturdy handle. The mug bears a black label with white text stating 'HANDMADE IN POLAND,' which is affixed to its side. The base of the mug has a thick, stable appearance.

recall_description: The mini fireplace, which houses the candle, can ignite, posing a fire hazard.
product_name: Candle kit with mini fireplace and booklet
remedies: Consumers should stop using this recalled product immediately and return it for a full refund to the place of purchase, or directly to the company mentioned in the recall notice.
visual_product_description: The product includes a small plastic fireplace designed to mimic stone masonry with a black mantle. It measures approximately 2.5 inches in height and width. A tea light candle fits inside, and a booklet accompanies the set. The packaging is colorful, displaying a fire motif and the words 'Fireplace in a Box.'

recall_description: A crack can occur between the power adapter's upper and lower cases, possibly causing them to separate and expose electrical wiring, posing electrical shock and electrocution hazards.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the power adaptor and contact the company for a free replacement. The company will provide a free replacement to any consumer who purchased a mixing console containing the defective adapter or purchased the adapter as a stand-alone item.
visual_product_description: A black rectangular power adapter with a long, attached black cord with a plug for electrical sockets. On the front, it has a label indicating specifications, including input and output voltage details. The back may contain date code information. The adapter's design shows separate casing components, potentially allowing for case separation if cracked.

recall_description: The recalled children's pajama sets violate the flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the recalled pajamas away from children, stop using them, and contact the seller to receive a full refund. Consumers should destroy the garments by cutting the top and bottom in half and disposing of them in accordance with local and state recycling laws. A photo of the destroyed garments should be sent to the recalling firm to receive a refund. The seller is contacting all known purchasers directly.
visual_product_description: The pajama set consists of a gray shirt with navy blue sleeves, red cuffs, and red collar, featuring prominent "I LOVE DAD" text on the front. The matching gray pants have "I LOVE DAD" text printed all over and are finished with red ankle cuffs.

recall_description: The plates have elevated levels of lead and formaldehyde, which are toxic if ingested by children and can cause adverse health effects.
remedies: Consumers should return the plates to the store for a full refund or follow instructions for proper disposal to receive a refund.
visual_product_description: A bamboo plate shaped like a popular bear character's face, featuring carved facial details such as eyes, nose, and a gentle smile. The ears are part of the plate's shape, and the entire design is made from a light brown bamboo material.

recall_description: The recalled chests are unstable and can tip over if not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the chests if not anchored to the wall and keep them away from children. Contact the manufacturer to receive a free tip-over restraint kit and a one-time, in-home installation of the wall anchor strap is available.
visual_product_description: The product is a four-drawer chest available in three finishes: black, oak, and white. It features round, protruding handles on each drawer for easy grip. The chest has a boxy structure with a flat top surface suitable for placing decorative items. The finish is smooth, offering a sleek appearance in each of the available colors.

recall_description: The motorcycle's drive chain can break while in use, causing the vehicle to suddenly lose its drive force, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled off-road motorcycles and contact an authorized dealer to schedule an appointment for a free repair. The company is contacting all known purchasers directly.
visual_product_description: This off-road motorcycle is designed with a predominantly red color scheme. It features an exposed frame and mechanical components, highlighting its rugged build for off-road use. The motorcycle is equipped with large knobbly tires suitable for rough terrain. The front suspension is prominent, and there is a robust exhaust system on the side. It has a sleek, aerodynamic body with distinct angular fenders and a compact seat tailored for aggressive riding positions. The handlebar is equipped with standard controls for off-road handling.

recall_description: If the acceleration pedal on the battery-operated ride-on toy becomes clogged with debris, it can stick after the user's foot is removed from the pedal, posing a crash hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the 24V ride-on cars and contact the manufacturer to receive a free repair kit. The repair kit includes a free replacement pedal with installation instructions.
visual_product_description: The ride-on toy car is designed with a fun and vibrant color scheme—red, white, and blue. It features a sleek, aerodynamic design. A prominent letter 'M' is displayed in the center of a white circle on its red front panel. The vehicle has a black frame that holds the steering wheel, which is simple and rounded. The wheels are large, sturdy, and capable of handling various terrains. Yellow accent colors are visible on the wheels, which have patterns mimicking stylized hubcaps. The seating area is fitted with a dark blue seat, and the sides of the car have decorative elements meant to imitate a racecar style.

recall_description: The frames of the recalled cargo bicycles can crack and can bend and break, posing a fall hazard to the rider.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled cargo bicycles, and contact the company for a full refund and to arrange for pickup of the bicycle.
visual_product_description: This is a cargo bicycle featuring a large front loading compartment designed for carrying children, pets, or light goods. It is available in both two-wheeled and three-wheeled versions and may be electric or non-electric. The bicycle includes handlebars, a seat, and a stand for stability when stationary.

recall_description: Paint on the zipper pull contains levels of lead that exceed the maximums allowed. Excessive levels of lead can be toxic or cause other health problems to young children if the paint is ingested.
product_name: Small wool sweaters with hood and zipper
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the recalled sweater away from children and contact the seller for a full refund.
visual_product_description: A small children's hooded wool sweater with a dark gray base color featuring multi-colored patterns. The sweater has a zipper down the front and drawstrings at the top and bottom of the zipper path. The patterns include geometric shapes in blue, orange, white, and black.

recall_description: The antifreeze products contain the substance ethylene glycol which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The products' caps were not rotated enough during manufacturing to engage the child resistant mechanism, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately inspect the product and twist the cap to ensure the child resistant mechanism is engaged.
visual_product_description: Yellow gallon-sized jug with a black cap and a handle. The front label includes instructions that it is ready to use and suitable for all vehicles. It provides mileage usage information and details regarding its concentration and dilution, all in bold black text.

recall_description: Inconsistent tire pressure information can result in improperly-inflated tires, posing a crash hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled vehicles and contact the manufacturer for a new tire pressure label and addendum to the owner's manual. All known purchasers are being contacted directly by the firm.
visual_product_description: Two-seat, side-by-side off-highway vehicle with rugged tires and a robust suspension system. The design is built for outdoor and off-road use, featuring a roll cage for passenger safety. It includes a cargo space at the back and has a distinctive red color with black accents. The vehicle has all-terrain capabilities, suitable for varied outdoor conditions.

recall_description: The metal wire in the shepherd's staff can become exposed, posing a laceration hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately discard the toy's wire staff and contact the company for a full refund in the form of a gift certificate. The plush toy can be used without the shepherd's staff.
visual_product_description: The toy features a boy figure dressed in a white robe with a red vest, tied with a green sash. It wears sandals and has cartoon-like features with a smiling face, green eyes, orange yarn hair, and is holding a shepherd's staff wrapped in fabric.

recall_description: The top loop of the fixture can bend and break causing the chandelier to fall, posing an impact and laceration hazard to consumers.
remedies: Prevent people from going into the immediate area underneath the chandelier and contact for a free repair.
visual_product_description: A chandelier with a bronze finish, featuring nine individual light sockets. Each socket is covered by a white glass cylinder shade. The chandelier stands 28¼ inches tall and spans 31¼ inches in width. It includes a central supporting structure with two circular tiers holding the light sockets and a loop at the top for ceiling suspension.

recall_description: The lower side of the stroller frame can crack, posing a fall risk to children in the stroller.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled strollers and contact the company to receive a frame reinforcement kit to secure the frame.
visual_product_description: A stroller made of aluminum with a sturdy build. It features a dual seating arrangement, both seats are black with safety harnesses, and it includes two adjustable canopies in a light blue color. The stroller frame is silver-colored, with both a basket underneath and black wheels designed for smooth maneuverability.

recall_description: The power banks can overheat, posing a fire hazard
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled banks and return them to any nearby store for a free replacement product or for a full refund. If you are unable to return it to a store, contact instructions on how to dispose of the power bank to receive a full refund. Proof of purchase (receipt) is not required to receive a full refund.
visual_product_description: Blue rectangular electronic device featuring a USB-A port and a USB-C port. It has rounded edges and a single circular button on the surface. The device is compact and portable, suitable for charging electronic devices on the go.

recall_description: The toy's information sticker can become exposed and detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Stop using the product and contact the seller for instructions to remove and dispose of the sticker or obtain a refund. The product can be returned using a prepaid mailer or directly to the retail store.
visual_product_description: A set of wooden stacking toys in rainbow shapes, featuring six pieces in varying pastel colors. The toys come in two size options: approximately 7 inches and 11 inches. The color combinations include green and blue, or pink and blue. The toys have a smooth, glossy finish.

recall_description: A damaged receiver mount on the stroller can cause the car seat to disengage and fall unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard to infants in the car seat.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the Click & Go receiver mounts and contact for a free repair kit. Double stroller users should not use them with the car seat attached. They can continue using the stroller or car seat independently.
visual_product_description: A foldable stroller featuring a robust frame with three wheels, two at the back and one at the front. It includes a car seat attachment mechanism known as Click & Go, designed to secure a car seat carrier onto the stroller. The stroller is designed for single or double occupancy and has various model identifiers located near the wheels for either configuration. The fabric canopy is adjustable, and the stroller incorporates a safety harness system. Overall structure reveals user-friendly handling bars and a collapsible frame for portability.

recall_description: The aluminum hardware supporting the shower seat can corrode, posing fall and laceration hazards.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled shower seats and contact to receive a full refund.
visual_product_description: The shower seat features teak wood slats joined together by support rods extending from two wall mounting brackets. The support rods and bracket covers come in finishes like brushed nickel, chrome, or oil-rubbed bronze. The seat's dimensions are 16 inches wide by 13.5 inches deep, with 11.75 inches between the wall mounting brackets.

recall_description: The Posi-Lok locking ring can disengage from the lower tank shell, allowing the top shell of the filter to blow off, causing injury to nearby consumers.
product_name: Modular pool filter for above ground pools and small in-ground pools
remedies: Consumers should verify their filter's model and serial numbers and not disturb the filter. A replacement locking ring and installation instructions will be provided, along with reimbursement for shipping back the old ring. Professional repair is available for consumers uncomfortable with replacement.
visual_product_description: The filter is a cylindrical tank that measures approximately 27 inches in height and 18 inches in diameter. It has a label with 'Modular Media' printed on it. The label includes specifications such as model number starting with 'PLM', maximum working pressure of 50 PSI (345 KPA), filtration area of 150 sq. ft. (14 sq. m.), and maximum flow rate of 56 GPM (212 LPM). It also mentions testing for fresh water only, and usage in swimming pools, spas, and hot tubs. There is also information about replacement modules, required space dimensions, and cleaning instructions. The product is made in Delavan, WI, U.S.A.

recall_description: The recalled lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms and were not tested to federal regulatory requirements for child resistance. Young children under 5 years of age could ignite the lighters, posing fire and burn hazards.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using and dispose of the recalled promotional cigar lighters.
visual_product_description: The product is a slim, rectangular lighter, measuring roughly 3 inches in height, 1.5 inches in width, and 0.25 inches in depth. It features a gold ignition mechanism at the top and a blue flame when lit. The body of the lighter is white, with a portion that is also available in brown or red.

recall_description: The chairs' leg base can break, posing fall and injury hazards.
remedies: Consumers should cease using the chairs immediately and return them to receive a full refund. Proof of purchase is not needed.
visual_product_description: A swivel chair in a dark gray (anthracite) shade featuring a smooth, curved backrest with integrated armrests. The seat and backrest are molded from a single piece of material, giving it a seamless look. The chair stands on a sturdy base with four legs extending from the central support, providing balance and stability.

recall_description: The recalled replacement lower blade guards do not sufficiently cover the saw blade and can break when making a cut, posing an injury hazard to the user.
product_name: Replacement lower blade guards for 12-inch miter saws
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled replacement lower blade guards and contact the retailer for a free lower guard assembly kit and installation instructions. The retailer is contacting all known purchasers.
visual_product_description: The product is a blade guard made of clear polycarbonate. It has a curved transparent section that covers the saw blade, attached to a grey base with a stamped description in the grey area. There is an additional black component on the bottom for support.

recall_description: The back of the chair can break or detach from the seat base when a consumer is seated, posing a fall hazard.
product_name: Office chairs with a circle cushioned seat, adjustable metal stand, and five wheels
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled chairs and contact the retailer for instructions on how to dispose of the chairs from home to receive a full refund. Consumers can also return the recalled chairs to any store location for a full refund.
visual_product_description: A chair with a circular cushioned seat that rests on an adjustable metal stand with five wheels. The metal is shiny, and the seat is upholstered in a smooth fabric. The backrest is a cushioned horizontal oval, attached to a simple metal support.

recall_description: The product contains methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if swallowed by young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately store the product in a safe location out of reach of children and contact the company for a full refund. The company is contacting all known purchasers directly.
visual_product_description: 4.4 fl. oz. (144 mL) and 8 fl. oz. (240 mL) amber plastic bottle with a white flip top lid. The bottle has a white oval label with purple accents displaying the product type and volume amount.

recall_description: Bottles were improperly filled with a product containing methanol and lacked mandatory cautionary labels, posing a poisoning hazard if ingested or inhaled.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the antifreeze and contact the manufacturer for a refund and disposal instructions. If already used in a water system, do not drink from it and contact the manufacturer for flushing instructions.
visual_product_description: A clear, one-gallon plastic bottle filled with blue liquid. It has a white screw cap and a front label with red and white text on a blue background. The bottle is transparent, allowing visibility of the liquid inside.

recall_description: The plastic housing surrounding the AC power adapter supplied with some Rest 1st Generation sound machines can come off when removing the adapter from the power outlet, leaving the power prongs exposed and posing a shock hazard.
remedies: Users should stop using the recalled power adapters immediately and contact the company for a free replacement adapter. They should unplug, cut the cord, take a photo showing the model number and cut cord, and provide contact details via the company's website. The company is contacting all registered owners directly.
visual_product_description: A white, conical device with a smooth surface, featuring a circular top with a grid pattern, likely the speaker area. The bottom of the cone is circled by a translucent band that may emit light. The overall design is sleek and minimalist.

recall_description: The recalled cooktop surface elements can turn on by themselves, posing burn and fire hazards.
remedies: Contact manufacturer for free installation of a replacement cooktop. Do not leave flammable materials on or near the cooktop.
visual_product_description: This is a black glass cooktop featuring five circular heating elements. Two of these are labeled as 'DuaL Element.' One smaller element is marked 'Warm Zone.' The surface has a sleek, modern design with a smooth, continuous glass surface. There are touch controls located at the bottom right corner of the cooktop, offering multiple functions and settings for cooking. The controls are visually integrated into the cooktop surface, contributing to a seamless appearance.

recall_description: The recalled harness can be put on backwards and the rope or carabiner can be attached to a non-weight-bearing leg loop elastic band, placing the user at risk of falling from height and sustaining serious injury, including paraplegia or death.
remedies: Consumers and operators should stop using the harnesses and contact the distributor for a free repair.
visual_product_description: The harness features a waistband with a green loop at the back for easy identification, adjustable straps with metallic buckle fasteners, and an orange and grey leg loop system. The main structure is dark gray with visible stitching, and there are two leg loops connected by a central belay loop.

recall_description: The clutch belt can break and damage the secondary clutch and the fuel line, posing a fire hazard to the rider.
product_name: Off-road vehicles with two or four seats
remedies: Consumers should stop using and contact a dealer for a free inspection and repair.
visual_product_description: A robust off-road vehicle with a sturdy frame and large all-terrain tires, designed for rugged terrains. It features a spacious cabin with two seats, a pronounced front grille, a detailed bumper, and a utility bed at the back. The vehicle is colored metallic gray and has visible shock absorbers and protective mud flaps. Equipped with distinctive headlights and side mirrors, the frame includes rollover protection.

recall_description: Flames from the votive candle can set fire to the rope linking three sledding snowmen.
remedies: Stop using the candleholder immediately and return it to the company to receive a gift certificate for the full purchase price and shipping expense.
visual_product_description: A decorative item featuring three snowman figurines in red, blue, and green winter clothing linked by a small rope. They are positioned as if sledding down a snowy hill, surrounding a glass votive candleholder. A small green pine tree is part of the display. The base has a sparkly snow appearance, enhancing the winter theme.

recall_description: The shower bench can collapse during use, posing a fall hazard to the user.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled shower benches and return them to the retailer for a full refund.
visual_product_description: A light brown teak bench with four legs and protective padding on the feet. The top serves as a seat with a row of wood panels, and there is a bottom shelf also made of wooden paneling. The overall design is sturdy with natural wood aesthetics, ideal for shower use.

recall_description: If the oven liner is not cut or configured for the exact specifications of the oven and it is placed over any vents or other openings in the oven, carbon monoxide can build up, posing a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled oven liners. Consumers who have not received their refund should contact the company.
visual_product_description: The product includes three black fiberglass liners that are extra thick. They have a smooth finish and are designed to be placed inside the oven. The packaging indicates it is a set of three and mentions 'grip' capabilities for secure placement.

recall_description: The infant walkers fail to meet the federal safety standard. They can fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step as required by the federal safety standard. The walkers also have leg openings that allow the child to slip down until the child's head can become entrapped at the neck. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled infant walkers and contact the seller via e-mail to receive a shipping label to return the infant walker free of charge. Upon receipt of the infant walker, consumers will be issued a full refund of the purchase price.
visual_product_description: This is a collapsible infant walker with an adjustable height setting. It has a circular frame with multiple wheels for movement. The seat is black and is supported by metal rods. The tray is white and circular, providing space for attachments or toys.

recall_description: The children's robes violate the flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children.
remedies: Consumers should take the recalled robes away from children, stop using them, and contact the company for a full refund. They should destroy the garments by cutting them in half, send a photo of the destroyed garment to the company's specified email, and afterwards, dispose of the destroyed garments properly. Upon receipt of the photo, the company will refund consumers the purchase price.
visual_product_description: The image displays a children's robe with long sleeves and a hood. It has two front pockets and a matching belt for closure. The robe shown is a solid color with a plush texture, indicative of terry cloth material.

recall_description: The children's nightgowns and two-piece pajama sets fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children.
product_name: Children's nightgowns and two-piece pajama sets
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the recalled nightgowns and two-piece pajama sets away from children and contact the company for a gift card for the full purchase price to use towards any product.
visual_product_description: The image depicts a two-piece pajama set made of 100% cotton. The top features long sleeves, a rounded collar, and has five white plastic buttons along the front, with two large pockets on either side near the waist. The set is designed with a red and white vertical striped pattern. The pants are of matching material, without visible added elements.

recall_description: The product was not in child-resistant packaging, posing a risk of chemical burns and irritation. It also violated labeling requirements by omitting mandatory information.
remedies: Consumers should store it safely out of reach of children and contact the company for a refund and a free warning label. The company is contacting purchasers directly.
visual_product_description: The product is packaged in a silver zip-top bag available in two sizes: 500 grams and 1 kilogram. The front of the bag features a white and blue label with the text 'LYE CAUSTIC SODA/SODIUM HYDROXIDE.' The back includes weight information and batch numbers. The overall appearance is sleek and minimalist with a focus on the text elements for product identification.

recall_description: The helmets do not comply with the positional stability requirements of the CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets, posing a risk of head injury.
product_name: Multi-purpose kids helmets with protective gear set
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled helmets immediately and contact the responsible company for a full refund.
visual_product_description: A set includes a blue helmet with an outer space pattern design. The helmet has black adjustable straps and a red buckle. Additionally, the set contains elbow, knee, and wrist guards, with a combination of blue and black colors, featuring hard plastic protective shells.

recall_description: The mugs can crack when filled with hot liquid, posing a burn hazard to users.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled mugs and receive a full refund or merchandise credit.
visual_product_description: A black stoneware mug with a smooth, matte finish. It features a cylindrical body, slightly tapering at the base, and a comfortable, rounded handle. The interior is a contrasting light color, adding to its minimalist design.

recall_description: The aluminum frame pieces could have experienced thermal damage during a non-standard paint stripping operation and can bend or buckle, posing a fall hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the bicycles with affected aluminum frames and contact the company for a free inspection. They can choose either a free replacement aluminum frame or a refund voucher for the recalled frame.
visual_product_description: A mountain bike with large tires suitable for off-road cycling. The frame is made from aluminum and is painted in a dark color. It features a high-rise handlebar with brake and gear shift levers. The bike includes a front suspension fork for absorbing shocks, and a robust seat post with a comfortable saddle. The bike also has disc brakes and a multi-speed gear system with a derailleur.

The handlebars are equipped for comfortable grip and control, and there is a distinct large battery compartment integrated into the frame design. The bike includes visible mechanical disc brakes positioned on the front and rear wheels.

recall_description: The blocked vent temperature switch (BVTS) can malfunction, causing the release of gases including carbon monoxide, posing a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning.
remedies: Consumers should contact the manufacturer to arrange for repairs by a certified technician at no cost. Use carbon monoxide alarms if continued use is necessary while awaiting the repair.
visual_product_description: A rectangular, metallic boiler unit with a digital display and various pipes connected on the top and sides. The control panel is situated on the front side along with ventilation slots, and the structure is supported by a sturdy base.

recall_description: The recalled helmets do not comply with the positional stability and labeling and certification requirements of the U.S. CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled helmets and contact the company for a full refund. The helmets should be destroyed by cutting off the straps, and proof of destruction should be submitted. Consumers will then be able to dispose of the helmets.
visual_product_description: The helmets come in various color combinations, including Black, Pink, Green, Yellow, Orange, Red, White, Blue, and Purple. They have a sleek design with multiple aerodynamic vents and are constructed with a glossy exterior shell. The interior features padding for comfort, and they include adjustable black and silver straps with a red buckle for securing the helmet in place.

recall_description: The tiki torch top can break open and/or fall off while lit, posing a burn hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled torches and contact the seller for a full refund. Destroy and dispose of or return the product (with the fuel reservoir empty) to receive a refund.
visual_product_description: Outdoor tiki torches with wide tops, available in copper, nickel, black, or gray finishes. Each torch has a circular metal holder with a decorative flame, supported on a wrought iron stake. The torches feature a fiberglass wick and are designed to be 72 inches tall.

recall_description: The shade's chain or cord loop can slip out of the hold-down device, posing a strangulation hazard for small children.
product_name: custom-made window shades with cord hold-down device
remedies: Consumers can obtain a free retrofit kit with a new hold-down device and instructions for replacement or have the new device fitted at a local showroom.
visual_product_description: The image shows a roller window shade with a beaded chain loop used to adjust the height of the shade. The chain is connected to a clear, P-shaped plastic hook on the side, which is screwed into the wall or window frame. The hook is designed to hold the chain securely to prevent it from becoming a hazard. The shade material appears to be a tightly woven fabric in a neutral color and is framed by a wooden structure.

recall_description: The front and/or rear wheel can collapse, causing the rider to fall and suffer injuries.
remedies: Consumers should stop riding immediately and contact the manufacturer for replacement wheels at no cost.
visual_product_description: This is a high-performance electric bicycle with a sturdy frame available in a vibrant red and sleek silver finish. It features a top tube and down tube with identifying stickers. The front and rear wheels are equipped with a battery and motor, respectively. The bicycle includes a derailleur system and an ergonomic seat. Handlebars are equipped with controls for maneuvering and operating the electric components.

recall_description: Sold with hazard warnings, but if two or more magnets are swallowed, they can cause serious internal injury such as intestinal obstructions and perforations.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the product and return it for a full refund.
visual_product_description: A mass of 231 small, shiny metal spheres that are powerful magnets. Each magnet is approximately 5mm in diameter. They come packaged in a circular metal canister with a lid, which is about 2.5 inches in diameter and 1.5 inches tall. The magnets are displayed forming a triangular pyramid shape both inside and outside the container.

recall_description: AC adaptors with certain date codes and serial numbers can overheat and melt, posing risks of fire, burn, and shock injuries.
product_name: AC Adaptors for slim gaming console systems
remedies: Consumers should stop using the adaptors immediately and contact the company to receive a free replacement. Unplug the adaptors carefully and allow them to cool before handling.
visual_product_description: The image shows a slim gaming console along with a gaming controller. The console has a minimalist design with a dark matte finish. It is rectangular in shape with a slightly raised center ridge line. The console stands vertically on a circular base. The controller is in a matching dark color, featuring dual analog sticks, a directional pad, square, circle, triangle, and cross buttons, as well as shoulder buttons on the top.

recall_description: The diving hose on specific brand name equipment can rupture.
product_name: high pressure scuba diving air hoses
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the hoses and contact the appropriate companies to receive instructions for obtaining a free replacement hose.
visual_product_description: The image shows a high-pressure scuba air hose with a black braided exterior. The hose appears to be coiled and is packed within a clear plastic bag. The metal fittings at both ends of the hose are visible, suggesting connections to a regulator. There's a red caution label inside the packaging, and the packaging shows typical plastic wrapping for retail display.

recall_description: The outlet converters front outlet prongs are not configured correctly, resulting in reverse polarity when plugs inserted, posing shock and fire hazards.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled outlet converters and can receive a refund.
visual_product_description: The product is a white plastic outlet converter that transforms a single electrical outlet into three outlets. The converter has an outlet plug on the left, front, and right side, measuring 1.7 inches tall, 1.3 inches wide, and 1.69 inches deep. The design includes two prongs on one side for plugging into an existing outlet. The overall appearance is compact and the structure is box-like with rounded edges.

recall_description: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The pain and itch relief cream contains lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately place the recalled product out of the reach of children and return it to the store for a full refund.
visual_product_description: The product consists of a tube and a box packaging. Both are predominantly orange with a purple stripe running vertically. Prominent text on the front reads 'Maximum Strength' and 'Pain and Itch Relief Cream 4% Lidocaine,' with net weight '2 OZ (56.7 grams)' listed. Additional description includes instructions on use and warnings. The back of the box contains a UPC bar code.

recall_description: The portable generators have a wiring error which can result in an electrical shock to users.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled generators and contact the seller to schedule a free repair by an authorized dealer.
visual_product_description: A portable generator with a blue casing and a black frame. It features an electric start and wheels for mobility. The generator includes multiple outlets on the side, protected by black covers, and has a visible control panel with gauges and switches. The unit's design includes a sturdy construction with handles for transport.

recall_description: The latch mechanism that holds the battery in place can malfunction, causing the battery to dislodge from the frame and fall to the ground, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Additionally, the latch spring can cause additional wear on the battery housing over time, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycles and contact their authorized dealer to arrange for a free repair to replace the latch spring mechanism and install a battery wear plate.
visual_product_description: The electric bicycle features a sleek frame available in two colors, Gloss Avocado Green and Maritime Gray. It has an integrated battery compartment located under the frame, with large tires and robust suspension for off-road or mountain biking.

recall_description: Fuel can leak from under the fuel cap, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled utility vehicles immediately and contact an authorized dealer for a free inspection, and if necessary, free repair. The manufacturer is contacting all known purchasers directly.
visual_product_description: A four-wheeled utility vehicle with side-by-side seating for two or four people. The vehicle features a vibrant green color with yellow accents on the wheels and detailing. It includes a robust protective frame, a cargo box at the back, and sturdy off-road tires designed for various terrains. The seating area is protected by a roof and open sides, allowing for easy access.

recall_description: The recalled mugs can crack or break when filled with hot liquid, posing burn and laceration hazards.
product_name: Ceramic mugs with animal ear design and bear-themed text
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled mugs and return them to the store for a full refund.
visual_product_description: A white ceramic mug with a "PAPA BEAR" decal in black. The mug features protruding animal ears on the rim, contributing to its distinctive design. The handle is solid and integrated into the mug body, providing a sturdy grip. It has a smooth finish and a slightly curved silhouette.
